definition_zh: 海底峡谷；深海峡谷（切入大陆架与大陆坡的狭长深谷）
definition_en: a long, deep, steep-sided valley cut into the seafloor, typically across the continental shelf and slope
core_image: 一道比陆上大峡谷更长更深的沟壑，从大陆架边缘一路切进深海，谷壁陡直，谷底有浑浊的水流在走
scene: 科考船沿着大陆坡放下声呐，屏幕上显出一道深深切入海底的长沟。The submarine canyon cuts a deep channel across the continental shelf.
sceneCN: 这里 submarine canyon 指「切入海底的狭长深谷」（第 1 个义项：作为完整地貌单位的深长沟谷）；句意为这条海底峡谷在大陆架上切出一条深水道。

pos.zh: 海底峡谷（可数，复数 submarine canyons）

collocations.phrase: the axis of a submarine canyon

derivatives.zh: canyon（借自西班牙语 cañón，源自拉丁 canna「芦苇、管」）→ 峡谷：两侧陡峭的狭长深谷
sub-（拉丁「在下」）+ mare（拉丁「海」）+ -ine → 海面之下的；潜艇
sub-（在下）+ mergere（拉丁「沉入」）+ -ible（能……的）→ 能潜入水下的：深潜器
submarine（海底的）+ fan（扇）→ 峡谷出口处堆积的扇形沉积体：海底扇

senses.title: A deep valley on the seafloor
senses.titleCN: 海底深谷：切入海底的狭长沟谷
senses.definition: a long, deep, steep-sided valley cut into the seafloor
senses.definitionCN: 切入海底的长而深、两侧陡峭的沟谷
senses.example: The submarine canyon cuts a deep channel across the continental shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 这条海底峡谷在大陆架上切出一条深水道。
senses.why: submarine supplies the place and canyon supplies the shape, so the compound names a gorge that lies below the sea surface.
senses.whyCN: submarine 提供位置，canyon 提供形状，复合词因此命名「位于海面之下的峡」。

senses.title: The steep bounding walls
senses.titleCN: 谷壁：两侧近乎陡直的坡面
senses.definition: the steep rock walls that bound the canyon on both sides
senses.definitionCN: 从两侧夹住峡谷的陡峭岩壁
senses.example: Sediment slides down the submarine canyon walls after storms.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴过后，沉积物沿海底峡谷的谷壁滑落。
senses.why: a canyon is defined by its walls as much as by its floor, so the term is also used for the bounding slopes.
senses.whyCN: 峡谷不只由谷底定义，也由谷壁定义，因此该词也用来指两侧的陡坡。

senses.title: The floor and axis
senses.titleCN: 谷底与轴部：物质下行的通道
senses.definition: the lowest line of the canyon, along which water and sediment travel seaward
senses.definitionCN: 峡谷最低的一条线，水与沉积物沿它向海方向移动
senses.example: Coarse sand collects along the submarine canyon floor.
senses.exampleCN: 粗砂堆积在海底峡谷的谷底。
senses.why: the word keeps canyon's sense of a passage, and the floor is where that passage actually conducts material.
senses.whyCN: 这个词保留 canyon「通道」的意思，而谷底正是通道真正输送物质的地方。

senses.title: A feature cut by turbidity currents
senses.titleCN: 成因：由浊流与滑塌长期下切
senses.definition: a landform shaped mainly by sediment-laden currents that erode the slope over long periods
senses.definitionCN: 主要由夹带泥沙的水流长期侵蚀斜坡而形成的地貌
senses.example: Geologists attribute the submarine canyon to repeated turbidity currents.
senses.exampleCN: 地质学家把这条海底峡谷归因于反复发生的浊流。
senses.why: the name describes the shape rather than the cause, and the cause is inferred from the eroded walls and the deposits below.
senses.whyCN: 名称描述的是形状而非成因，成因是从受侵蚀的谷壁与下方沉积推断出来的。

senses.title: A conduit for sediment
senses.titleCN: 沉积物通道：把陆源泥沙输往深海
senses.definition: a route that carries sand and mud from the shelf down to the deep sea
senses.definitionCN: 把砂与泥从大陆架向下送到深海的路径
senses.example: The submarine canyon feeds a fan of sand at its mouth.
senses.exampleCN: 这条海底峡谷在出口处养出一片砂质海底扇。
senses.why: because a canyon is a passage, the term also names the function of that passage in the sediment budget.
senses.whyCN: 由于峡谷本身是通道，该词也用来命名这条通道在沉积收支中的功能。

senses.title: A drowned river valley
senses.definition: a former river valley that was submerged when sea level rose
senses.definitionCN: 海面上涨后被淹没的旧河谷
senses.example: Some submarine canyons are drowned river valleys from the last low sea level.
senses.exampleCN: 有些海底峡谷是上次低海面时期被淹没的河谷。
senses.why: rising seas can put an old river valley underwater without changing its canyon-like shape.
senses.whyCN: 海面上升可以把旧河谷放到水下，却不改变它峡谷般的形状。

senses.title: A feature on a bathymetric chart
senses.definition: a named shape recognised on sonar records and bathymetric charts
senses.definitionCN: 在声呐记录与测深图上被识别并命名的形状
senses.example: The survey team mapped the submarine canyon in a single pass.
senses.exampleCN: 测量队一次航行就测绘出了这条海底峡谷。
senses.why: once named on charts, the canyon becomes a fixed reference point, a sense the term gains in survey work.
senses.whyCN: 一旦在海图上被命名，这条峡谷就成为固定参照，这是该词在测绘工作中获得的义项。

senses.title: A deep-water corridor and archive
senses.definition: a route and trap for organic matter that forms a habitat and a sedimentary record
senses.definitionCN: 聚集有机质的通道与陷阱，既形成栖息环境，也留下沉积记录
senses.example: The submarine canyon traps organic matter that feeds deep-water life.
senses.exampleCN: 这条海底峡谷截留的有机质供养着深水生物。
senses.why: the passage also concentrates food and sediment, so one word names the habitat and the record at once.
senses.whyCN: 这条通道同时聚集食物与沉积，于是一个词同时命名栖息环境与记录。

intro.en: Submarine canyon joins a Latin-derived adjective to a Spanish-derived noun. Submarine goes back to sub- 'under' plus mare 'sea'; canyon goes back through Spanish canon to Latin canna 'reed, tube'. The geological compound is a twentieth-century formation. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: submarine canyon 把一个拉丁语源的形容词与一个西班牙语源的名词接在一起。submarine 上溯 sub-「在下」加 mare「海」；canyon 经西班牙语 canon 上溯拉丁 canna「芦苇、管」。这个地质复合词是二十世纪的产物。年代均为约数。

items.en: Mare meant 'sea' and yielded the adjective marinus 'of the sea'; sub- meant 'under, below'. Together they give the later adjective submarine.
items.cn: mare 意为「海」，并衍生形容词 marinus「海的」；sub- 意为「在下、低于」。二者合起来产生后来的形容词 submarine。

items.en: Canna meant 'reed, tube', and Spanish cano 'tube' produced the augmentative canon, a large tube and hence a deep narrow gorge.
items.cn: canna 意为「芦苇、管」，西班牙语 cano「管」的增义形式 canon 指大管，进而指深而窄的峡。

items.en: Submarine appears in English in the seventeenth century as an adjective meaning 'beneath the sea'; the noun for the vessel follows at the end of the nineteenth century.
items.cn: submarine 于十七世纪以形容词身份进入英语，意为「海面之下的」；指舰船的名词义到十九世纪末才出现。

items.en: Canyon entered American English in the 1820s from Spanish, first naming dry gorges of the western interior.
items.cn: canyon 于十九世纪二十年代从西班牙语进入美式英语，最初指西部内陆的干旱峡谷。

items.en: Twentieth-century mapping of the continental margins revealed gorges under the sea, and the existing words were simply joined rather than a new term coined.
items.cn: 二十世纪对大陆边缘的测绘揭示出水下的深谷，人们直接把现成的两个词接起来，而没有另造新词。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the two words are well documented, but the compound's earliest citation is dated differently across references and no single first use is established.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代存疑）：两个词本身记载清楚，但复合词的最早书证各家年代不一，没有公认的首次使用。

note.en: Group one holds the seafloor features most often mistaken for a submarine canyon; group two holds the land and deep-ocean terms with a similar shape.
note.cn: 第一组是常被误认成海底峡谷的海底地貌；第二组是形状相近的陆地与深海术语。

entries.definition: A fan-shaped body of sediment laid down where a canyon opens onto the deep sea; it is built up, while the canyon is cut down.
entries.definitionCN: 峡谷口开向深海处堆出的扇形沉积体；它是堆积而成，而峡谷是切割而成。

entries.definition: The sloping edge between shelf and deep ocean floor; a canyon is a notch cut into this slope, not the slope itself.
entries.definitionCN: 大陆架与深海海底之间的斜坡；峡谷是切进这道斜坡的沟，而不是斜坡本身。

entries.definition: A broad, almost level expanse of deep ocean floor beyond the slope; it has no steep walls and no down-cutting.
entries.definitionCN: 斜坡之外广阔而近乎平坦的深海海底；它没有陡壁，也没有下切。

entries.definition: A raised chain of underwater mountains formed where plates spread; it is constructional, whereas a canyon is erosional.
entries.definitionCN: 板块张开处形成的海底山脉链；它是构造抬升的，而峡谷是侵蚀下切的。

entries.definition: A deep gorge with steep sides, usually cut by a river on land; the seafloor term borrows this shape and adds the location.
entries.definitionCN: 两侧陡峭的深峡，通常由陆上河流切割；海底术语借用这一形状并补上位置。

entries.definition: A very deep, narrow depression at a subduction zone; it is formed by plate movement and reaches far greater depths than a canyon.
entries.definitionCN: 俯冲带处极深而窄的凹陷；由板块运动形成，深度远大于海底峡谷。

entries.definition: A small channel cut by running water; it is far shorter and shallower than a canyon and may grow into one.
entries.definitionCN: 流水切出的小沟；比峡谷短得多也浅得多，可能逐渐发育成峡谷。

entries.definition: Any low ground between hills or mountains; it says nothing about steep walls or an underwater setting.
entries.definitionCN: 山丘或山脉之间的低地；既不含陡壁之意，也不含水下环境之意。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real compounds and real seafloor terms, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的语素、真实的复合词与真实的海底术语，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: sub- 'under' plus mare 'sea' gives submarine: the place is below the water.
normal.cn: sub-「在下」加 mare「海」构成 submarine：位置就在水面之下。

normal.en: canyon goes back to Latin canna 'tube', a long hollow shape, which is exactly what a canyon is.
normal.cn: canyon 上溯拉丁 canna「管」，正是又长又空的样子，峡谷就是这样。

normal.en: A canyon is cut down; a fan is built up. The two words describe opposite directions of sediment work.
normal.cn: 峡谷是切下去的，海底扇是堆上来的；两个词描述沉积工作的相反方向。

normal.en: The chain of features runs shelf, slope, canyon, fan, plain, in the direction sediment travels.
normal.cn: 地貌链条按沉积行进方向排列：陆架、陆坡、峡谷、海底扇、深海平原。

normal.en: Turbidity currents are the excavators: muddy water denser than seawater runs downhill and saws the slope.
normal.cn: 浊流是挖掘机：比海水重的浑水顺坡下行，把斜坡锯开。

abstract.en: A submarine canyon is a river's handwriting preserved under the sea.
abstract.cn: 海底峡谷是河流的字迹，被海水保存了下来。

abstract.en: The canyon is a funnel that turns a continent's erosion into the deep sea's diet.
abstract.cn: 这条峡谷是一只漏斗，把大陆的侵蚀变成深海的食粮。

abstract.en: Its walls are a cut through time: each layer exposed is a page turned outward.
abstract.cn: 它的谷壁是一道切穿时间的剖面：每一层露出的岩层都是一页向外翻开的书。

examples.en: The submarine canyon funnels sand from the shelf into the abyssal plain.
examples.cn: 这条海底峡谷把砂从大陆架输送到深海平原。

examples.en: Sonar revealed a submarine canyon deeper than the Grand Canyon.
examples.cn: 声呐揭示出一条比大峡谷更深的海底峡谷。

examples.en: Divers avoid the submarine canyon because its currents are unpredictable.
examples.cn: 潜水员避开这条海底峡谷，因为其中水流难以预测。

dict_mnemonic.text: submarine（海底的）+ canyon（峡谷）＝切入海底的长沟；位置在水下，形状仍是峡谷，切下去的是浊流，堆上来的是海底扇。

root: submarine（sub-「在下」+ 拉丁 mare「海」）+ canyon（西班牙语 canon「管道、峡谷」，源自拉丁 canna「芦苇、管」）；地质义为二十世纪所立。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one cut in the seafloor: the gorge as a whole, its walls, its floor, the currents that cut it, the sediment it carries, a drowned river version, its charted name, and the habitat and record it creates.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿海底同一道切口展开：作为整体的沟谷、谷壁、谷底、切割它的水流、它输送的沉积、被淹没的河谷版本、海图上的名字，以及它造就的栖息环境与记录。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long deep notch cut into the edge of a continent, running from the shelf down to the abyss.
core.cn: 核心意象：大陆边缘被切出一道深长的缺口，从陆架一直通到深渊。

branches.en: SHAPE AND ORIGIN: the gorge itself, then an older river valley drowned by rising sea.
branches.cn: 形状与来源：先是沟谷本身，再是被海面上涨淹没的旧河谷。

branches.en: WALL AND FLOOR: the bounding slopes and the line along which material travels.
branches.cn: 壁与底：两侧的陡坡，以及物质行进所沿的那条线。

branches.en: CUT AND CONDUCT: erosion made the notch, and the notch now carries sediment seaward.
branches.cn: 切与送：侵蚀造出缺口，缺口如今把沉积送往海里。

branches.en: CHARTED OBJECT: a shape on a map becomes a fixed reference.
branches.cn: 图上对象：地图上的形状变成固定参照。

branches.en: CORRIDOR AND ARCHIVE: the passage concentrates food and keeps a record.
branches.cn: 走廊与档案：通道聚集食物，也留下记录。

intro.en: Submarine canyon is a two-word compound whose halves each carry readable morphology, so both the location and the shape can be spelled out.
intro.cn: submarine canyon 是由两个词构成的复合词，两半各自带有可读的构词信息，因此位置与形状都能逐段说明。

latinIntro.en: Latin mare and its adjective marinus supply the first half; Latin canna supplies the second half through Spanish. The compound itself is English, not Latin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 mare 及其形容词 marinus 提供前半；拉丁 canna 经西班牙语提供后半。复合词本身是英语，不是拉丁语。

items.example: The prefix places the whole feature beneath the surface.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把整个地貌置于水面之下。

items.structure: mare, maris (Latin noun, neuter, third declension)
items.example: Mare is the Latin word for the open sea.
items.exampleCN: mare 是拉丁语中「开阔海面」的词。

items.example: Marinus supplied the -ine of submarine.
items.exampleCN: marinus 提供了 submarine 的词尾。

items.structure: canna, cannae (Latin noun, feminine, first declension)
items.example: Canna gave Spanish cano and English canyon.
items.exampleCN: canna 经由西班牙语 cano 给出英语 canyon。

items.example: The canyon walls rise almost vertically.
items.exampleCN: 峡谷的岩壁几乎垂直升起。

items.meaning: existing or operating beneath the sea
items.meaningCN: 存在于海面之下或在海下运作的
items.example: Submarine cables carry most international traffic.
items.exampleCN: 海底电缆承载大部分国际通信。

items.meaning: a deep valley cut into the seafloor
items.example: The submarine canyon runs for two hundred kilometres.
items.exampleCN: 这条海底峡谷延伸两百公里。

items.example: The submarine fan lies beyond the canyon mouth.
items.exampleCN: 海底扇位于峡谷出口之外。

items.meaning: the slope between shelf and abyssal floor
items.meaningCN: 陆架与深海平原之间的斜坡
items.example: Canyons notch the continental slope.
items.exampleCN: 峡谷在大陆坡上切出缺口。

definition_zh: 热液的；水热作用的（指热水或热流体在岩层与海底循环所形成的地质过程）
definition_en: relating to hot water or hot fluids circulating through rock, especially in the crust beneath the seafloor
core_image: 海水沿裂缝渗入灼热的岩层，被加热后又带着溶解的矿物喷回海底
scene: 科研人员从岩脊的裂缝中取到一管滚烫的矿物流体。Scientists sampled the hydrothermal fluids escaping from the ridge.
sceneCN: 这里 hydrothermal 指「与地下热水或热流体有关」（第 1 个义项：泛指由热流体参与的地质过程与产物）；句意为科学家采集从洋脊逸出的热液流体。

pos.zh: 热液的；水热作用的（地质学中指热水或热流体参与的过程）

derivatives.zh: therm-（希腊 thermē「热」）+ -al（形容词后缀）→ 热的：热量的、保暖的
hydrothermal + -ly（副词后缀）→ 以热液方式：经由热水或热流体作用地
hydrothermal + -ism（表过程或体系的名词后缀）→ 热液活动：热流体循环这一整套过程
geo-（希腊「大地」）+ thermal（热）→ 地热的：来自地球内部热量的（与 hydrothermal 共享 thermal 词根）

senses.title: Relating to hot water processes
senses.titleCN: 热液的：由热水或热流体参与的地质过程
senses.definition: concerning geological processes in which hot water or hot fluids move through rock
senses.definitionCN: 指热水或热流体在岩石中运移所形成的地质过程
senses.example: Scientists sampled the hydrothermal fluids escaping from the ridge.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家采集从洋脊逸出的热液流体。
senses.why: hydro- supplies water and thermal supplies heat, so the adjective simply names processes in which both are present.
senses.whyCN: hydro- 提供水，thermal 提供热，这个形容词因此直接命名同时具备两者的过程。

senses.title: Seawater heated by magma
senses.titleCN: 海水被岩浆加热的循环
senses.definition: the circulation in which seawater sinks into hot rock, is heated, and rises again
senses.definitionCN: 海水下渗进入灼热岩石、被加热后再上升的循环
senses.example: Hydrothermal circulation transfers heat from magma to the ocean.
senses.exampleCN: 热液循环把热量从岩浆传送到海洋。
senses.why: the adjective describes the fluid, and the circulation is the large-scale version of that same hot fluid moving.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词描述流体，而循环正是同一种热流体在大尺度上运动。

senses.title: Alteration of the surrounding rock
senses.titleCN: 热液蚀变：热流体改变岩石
senses.definition: the chemical change of rock caused by hot fluids passing through it
senses.definitionCN: 热流体穿过岩石时引起的化学变化
senses.example: Hydrothermal alteration turned the basalt into clay minerals.
senses.exampleCN: 热液蚀变把玄武岩变成了黏土矿物。
senses.why: hot water carries dissolved substances, so wherever it passes it exchanges material with the rock.
senses.whyCN: 热水携带溶解物质，因此它经过之处都会与岩石交换物质。

senses.title: The vent environment
senses.definition: the setting around a seafloor opening where hot fluid discharges
senses.definitionCN: 热流体从海底开口排出处的周边环境
senses.example: Hydrothermal conditions support chemosynthetic bacteria.
senses.exampleCN: 热液环境供养化能合成细菌。
senses.why: the adjective commonly modifies vent, field and plume, naming the environment rather than a single object.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词常修饰 vent、field 与 plume，命名的是环境，而不只是单个物体。

senses.title: Ore-forming hot fluids
senses.titleCN: 热液成矿：金属硫化物沉淀
senses.definition: the deposition of metal sulphides when hot mineral-rich fluid cools
senses.definitionCN: 富含金属的热流体冷却时沉淀出金属硫化物
senses.example: The deposit formed from hydrothermal solutions rich in copper.
senses.exampleCN: 该矿床由富含铜的热液沉淀形成。
senses.why: cooling fluid cannot hold its dissolved metals, so they settle out where the hot water meets cold seawater.
senses.whyCN: 热流体冷却后无法继续溶解金属，于是它们在热水与冷海水相遇处沉淀下来。

senses.title: Laboratory hydrothermal synthesis
senses.definition: a method of growing crystals in hot water under pressure
senses.definitionCN: 在高温高压的水中生长晶体的方法
senses.example: Quartz crystals are grown by a hydrothermal method.
senses.exampleCN: 石英晶体用水热法生长。
senses.why: the same two ingredients, water and heat, are used in a sealed vessel, so laboratory chemistry borrowed the geological adjective.
senses.whyCN: 同样的两个要素——水与热——被用在密闭容器里，于是实验室化学借用了这个地质形容词。

senses.title: Hydrothermal activity on other worlds
senses.titleCN: 其他天体上的热液活动
senses.definition: hot-fluid activity inferred beneath the icy crusts of other planets and moons
senses.definitionCN: 在其他行星与卫星冰壳之下推断出的热流体活动
senses.example: Hydrothermal activity is suspected beneath the ice of that moon.
senses.exampleCN: 那颗卫星的冰层之下疑似存在热液活动。
senses.why: the word describes a physical process rather than a place, so it travels to any body where water and heat meet.
senses.whyCN: 这个词描述物理过程而非地点，因此可以迁移到任何水与热相遇的天体。

senses.title: A label in compound terms
senses.titleCN: 复合术语中的限定成分
senses.definition: the first element in fixed terms such as hydrothermal vent, field and plume
senses.definitionCN: 在 hydrothermal vent、field、plume 等固定术语中充当限定成分
senses.example: The hydrothermal plume spread hundreds of metres from the vent.
senses.exampleCN: 热液羽流从喷口扩散出数百米。
senses.why: technical English builds long names by stacking modifiers, and hydrothermal marks which kind of vent, field or plume is meant.
senses.whyCN: 技术英语靠层层修饰构成长名，hydrothermal 标明是何种喷口、热液场或羽流。

intro.en: Hydrothermal is built from two Greek roots and is a modern scientific coinage rather than an inherited word. Hydro- goes back to Greek hydor 'water', and thermal goes back to Greek therme 'heat'. Latin has no cognates of either root. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: hydrothermal 由两个希腊词根构成，是近代科学新造词，而非承继词。hydro- 上溯希腊 hydor「水」，thermal 上溯希腊 therme「热」。两个词根在拉丁语中都没有同族词。年代均为约数。

items.en: Hydor, with the stem hydat-, meant 'water' and appears in English in hydrology, hydrogen and dehydration.
items.cn: hydor（词干 hydat-）意为「水」，出现在英语的 hydrology、hydrogen 与 dehydration 中。

items.en: Therme meant 'heat' and also named hot springs; it produced thermal, thermometer and thermos.
items.cn: therme 意为「热」，也用来称温泉；它衍生出 thermal、thermometer 与 thermos。

items.en: Nineteenth-century geologists needed one adjective for the action of hot water on rock and combined the two roots to make it.
items.cn: 十九世纪的地质学家需要一个形容词来描述热水对岩石的作用，于是把两个词根合成了它。

items.en: The term spread through the study of ore deposits, where hot fluids were recognised as the carriers of metals.
items.cn: 这个词在矿床研究中传播开来，因为人们认识到热流体是金属的搬运者。

items.en: After the discovery of seafloor vents in the late twentieth century, hydrothermal became a standard word in oceanography and biology.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期海底喷口被发现后，hydrothermal 成为海洋学与生物学的标准用词。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin only): the pre-Greek origin of hydor is debated, and forms such as *wed- are reconstructions rather than attested words.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅更深词源存疑）：hydor 在希腊语之前的来源有争议，*wed- 一类形式属重构，而非有书证的词。

note.en: Group one holds the heat-related adjectives most often confused with hydrothermal; group two holds the process words that name the same setting from other angles.
note.cn: 第一组是常与 hydrothermal 混淆的热相关形容词；第二组是从别的角度命名同一环境的近义词。

entries.definition: Relating to heat from the Earth's interior; it does not require water, whereas hydrothermal always involves hot fluid.
entries.definitionCN: 指来自地球内部的热；不要求有水，而 hydrothermal 始终涉及热流体。

entries.definition: Relating to the movement and distribution of water; heat plays no part in the definition.
entries.definitionCN: 指水的运动与分布；定义中不含热。

entries.definition: Relating to heat or temperature in general; it is the second half of hydrothermal but lacks the water element.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指与热或温度有关；它是 hydrothermal 的后半，但没有水的成分。

entries.definition: The seafloor opening itself; hydrothermal alone describes the process or the fluid, not the opening.
entries.definitionCN: 指海底的那个开口本身；单用 hydrothermal 描述过程或流体，不指开口。

entries.definition: Relating to magma; it names the heat source, while hydrothermal names the water that the magma heats.
entries.definitionCN: 指与岩浆有关；它命名热源，而 hydrothermal 命名被岩浆加热的水。

entries.definition: Relating to volcanoes and their products; a hydrothermal system may be volcanic in origin but need not erupt.
entries.definitionCN: 指火山及其产物；热液系统可能源于火山，但并不需要喷发。

entries.definition: Relating to water in solution; it says nothing about temperature, which is the point of hydrothermal.
entries.definitionCN: 指水溶液中的；不涉及温度，而温度正是 hydrothermal 的要点。

entries.definition: Beneath the sea; it gives the setting but not the hot-fluid process.
entries.definitionCN: 指海面之下；只给出环境，不含热流体过程。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: two real Greek roots and real technical compounds, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个真实的希腊词根与真实的技术复合词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: hydro- means water, thermal means heat: hydrothermal is exactly water plus heat.
normal.cn: hydro- 是水，thermal 是热：hydrothermal 就是水加热。

normal.en: The pair of roots also builds hydrology and thermometer, so the family is easy to read.
normal.cn: 同一对词根还构成 hydrology 与 thermometer，词族容易读懂。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the field: hydrothermal vent, hydrothermal field, hydrothermal plume.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出领域：热液喷口、热液场、热液羽流。

normal.en: The process has three steps: seawater sinks, rock heats it, mineral-rich water rises.
normal.cn: 这个过程有三步：海水下渗、岩石加热、富含矿物的水上升。

normal.en: Ore deposits are the trace it leaves: metals precipitate where hot fluid meets cold seawater.
normal.cn: 矿床是它留下的痕迹：金属在热流体与冷海水相遇处沉淀。

abstract.en: Hydrothermal is the ocean breathing through hot stone.
abstract.cn: 热液是海洋透过灼热石头在呼吸。

abstract.en: It is a kitchen under pressure: water, heat and dissolved minerals in a sealed pot of rock.
abstract.cn: 它是一间加压的厨房：水、热与溶解矿物装在岩石这只密封锅里。

abstract.en: Where hot water meets cold sea, the invisible becomes stone.
abstract.cn: 热水与冷海相遇之处，看不见的东西变成了石头。

examples.en: Hydrothermal fluids carry dissolved metals from deep rock to the seafloor.
examples.cn: 热液把溶解的金属从深部岩石带到海底。

examples.en: The team mapped a hydrothermal field along the spreading ridge.
examples.cn: 团队沿扩张洋脊测绘了一处热液场。

examples.en: Hydrothermal alteration left a pale band in the dark basalt.
examples.cn: 热液蚀变在深色玄武岩中留下一条浅色带。

dict_mnemonic.text: hydro（水）+ thermal（热）＝热水参与的；记成「水加热，穿石头，带矿物，回海底」。

root: 希腊 hydor「水」+ 希腊 therme「热」；为十九世纪科学新造词，两个词根在拉丁语中均无同族词。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one hot fluid: it circulates, alters rock, marks an environment, deposits ore, is imitated in a lab, works on other worlds and finally becomes a fixed label in compound terms.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种热流体展开：它循环、改变岩石、标出环境、沉淀矿床、被实验室仿效、在其他天体上运作，最后成为复合术语中的固定标签。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: cold seawater slips into hot rock and returns carrying dissolved minerals.
core.cn: 核心意象：冷海水渗入灼热岩石，再带着溶解的矿物回来。

branches.en: THE CYCLE: water plus heat is first a general process, then a measurable circulation.
branches.cn: 循环：水加热先是泛指的过程，再是可测量的循环。

branches.en: ROCK CHANGED: passing fluid exchanges matter with the wall rock.
branches.cn: 岩石被改变：流经的流体与围岩交换物质。

branches.en: VENT AND ORE: the discharge point, and the metals that settle out of it.
branches.cn: 喷口与矿石：排出口，以及从中沉淀的金属。

branches.en: LABORATORY COPY: the same water and heat reproduced in a sealed vessel.
branches.cn: 实验室复制：同样的水与热在密闭容器中被重现。

branches.en: OTHER WORLDS AND FIXED LABELS: the process travels, and the word becomes a modifier.
branches.cn: 其他天体与固定标签：过程可以迁移，词本身变成限定成分。

intro.en: Hydrothermal is a combining-form compound: two bound Greek roots joined by a linking vowel, with no prefix of its own.
intro.cn: hydrothermal 是组合形式构成的复合词：两个黏着希腊词根以连接元音相接，本身不带前缀。

latinIntro.en: Both roots are Greek, so there are no Latin entries. Latin aqua 'water' and calor 'heat' express the same ideas from different roots and are not cognates.
latinIntro.cn: 两个词根都属希腊语，因此没有拉丁条目。拉丁 aqua「水」与 calor「热」用不同词根表达相同概念，并非同源。

items.example: Hydro- appears in hydrology and hydroelectric.
items.exampleCN: hydro- 出现在 hydrology 与 hydroelectric 中。

items.example: Hydor is the Greek source of the combining form.
items.exampleCN: hydor 是这个组合形式的希腊语来源。

items.example: Therme also named warm baths.
items.exampleCN: therme 也用来称温水浴场。

items.example: Thermal springs feed the pool.
items.exampleCN: 温泉为这个水池供水。

items.meaning: relating to hot water in rock
items.example: Hydrothermal fluids altered the basalt.
items.exampleCN: 热液改变了玄武岩。

items.example: Hydrothermalism shaped the ridge crest.
items.exampleCN: 热液活动塑造了洋脊顶部。

items.example: The hydrothermal vent supports dense life.
items.exampleCN: 这个热液喷口供养密集的生物。

items.meaning: a group of vents in one area
items.meaningCN: 同一区域内的一组喷口
items.example: The hydrothermal field extends for a kilometre.
items.exampleCN: 这处热液场延伸一公里。

items.meaning: the rising cloud of hot particle-rich water
items.meaningCN: 上升的、富含颗粒的热水云
items.example: A hydrothermal plume rose above the vent.
items.exampleCN: 一团热液羽流升到喷口上方。

items.example: Geothermal power uses steam from hot rock.
items.exampleCN: 地热发电利用热岩产生的蒸汽。

definition_zh: 热液喷口；海底热泉（热流体从海底裂隙喷出的开口）
definition_en: an opening on the seafloor where hot mineral-rich fluid discharges into cold seawater
core_image: 海底裂开一道缝，黑色的热水柱夹着矿物颗粒往上冲，遇冷立刻沉下一圈烟尘
scene: 深潜器悬停在裂隙上方，滚烫的黑色水流夹着矿物颗粒涌出。A hydrothermal vent pours mineral-rich water onto the seafloor.
sceneCN: 这里 hydrothermal vent 指「海底热流体喷出的开口」（第 1 个义项：作为地点的喷口本身）；句意为一个热液喷口把富含矿物的热水倾泻到海底。

pos.zh: 热液喷口；海底热泉（可数，复数 hydrothermal vents）

derivatives.zh: vent（拉丁 ventus「风」经「出风口」义而来）→ 开口、排气口；排放
hydro-（希腊「水」）+ thermal（希腊「热」）→ 热液的：热水参与的
black（黑）+ smoker（冒烟者）→ 喷出黑色矿物颗粒的高温喷口：黑烟囱
cold（冷）+ seep（渗漏）→ 低温流体缓慢渗出的海底地点：冷泉（与热液喷口相对）

senses.title: The opening itself
senses.titleCN: 喷口本体：热流体喷出的海底开口
senses.definition: the seafloor opening through which hot fluid discharges
senses.definitionCN: 热流体由此排出的海底开口
senses.example: A hydrothermal vent pours mineral-rich water onto the seafloor.
senses.exampleCN: 一个热液喷口把富含矿物的热水倾泻到海底。
senses.why: vent names an opening, and hydrothermal names the fluid, so the phrase is literally a hot-water outlet.
senses.whyCN: vent 命名开口，hydrothermal 命名流体，短语字面就是「热水的出口」。

senses.title: The rising plume
senses.titleCN: 上升的羽流：喷出的热水柱
senses.definition: the cloud of hot particle-laden water rising from the opening
senses.definitionCN: 从开口上升的、夹带颗粒的热水云
senses.example: A dark plume rose from the hydrothermal vent.
senses.exampleCN: 一股深色羽流从热液喷口升起。
senses.why: what the vent emits is continuous with the vent, so the word is used for the plume as well as the hole.
senses.whyCN: 喷口喷出的东西与喷口连成一体，因此这个词也用来指羽流而不只指洞口。

senses.title: The chimney it builds
senses.definition: the mineral structure built up around the opening by precipitated solids
senses.definitionCN: 沉淀物在开口周围堆成的矿物构造
senses.example: The hydrothermal vent grew a chimney two metres tall.
senses.exampleCN: 这个热液喷口长出一座两米高的烟囱。
senses.why: dissolved minerals settle where hot fluid meets cold seawater, so the opening slowly builds its own tower.
senses.whyCN: 溶解矿物在热流体与冷海水相遇处沉淀，于是开口慢慢筑起自己的塔。

senses.title: A chemosynthetic community
senses.definition: the assemblage of organisms that live on chemical energy at a vent
senses.definitionCN: 依靠化学能在喷口处生活的生物集合
senses.example: Tube worms crowd around the hydrothermal vent.
senses.exampleCN: 管虫密密地围着这个热液喷口。
senses.why: the vent supplies sulphides instead of sunlight, so the word also names the unique community it feeds.
senses.whyCN: 喷口提供的是硫化物而非阳光，因此这个词也命名它供养的独特群落。

senses.title: An exit of a circulation system
senses.definition: the discharge point of a larger hydrothermal circulation
senses.definitionCN: 更大规模热液循环的排出点
senses.example: Each hydrothermal vent marks where the circuit reaches the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 每个热液喷口都标出循环回到海面处。
senses.why: in a circuit, the vent is the outlet end, so the word describes a position in a system as well as a hole.
senses.whyCN: 在一个循环里，喷口是出口端，因此这个词既描述洞口，也描述系统中的一个位置。

senses.title: An ancient vent and its ore
senses.titleCN: 古喷口与块状硫化物矿
senses.definition: a former vent preserved in rock as a massive sulphide deposit
senses.definitionCN: 保存在岩石中、成为块状硫化物矿床的旧喷口
senses.example: Miners worked an ancient hydrothermal vent for copper.
senses.exampleCN: 矿工开采一处古热液喷口以获取铜。
senses.why: when the seafloor is lifted onto land, the vent and its chimney become an ore body.
senses.whyCN: 当海底被抬升到陆地上，喷口与烟囱就变成了矿体。

senses.title: A target for water-column survey
senses.definition: a feature located by detecting its plume in the water column
senses.definitionCN: 通过探测水柱中的羽流而定位的对象
senses.example: The ship found a hydrothermal vent by tracing a chemical anomaly.
senses.exampleCN: 这艘船通过追踪化学异常找到了一处热液喷口。
senses.why: the vent is hidden below, but its plume spreads above, so survey work treats the plume as the vent's signature.
senses.whyCN: 喷口藏在下面，羽流却扩散在上面，因此探测工作把羽流当作喷口的签名。

senses.title: An analogue on icy moons
senses.definition: a hypothetical seafloor vent beneath the ice of another world
senses.definitionCN: 其他天体冰层之下假想的海底喷口
senses.example: A hydrothermal vent under that ice could support life.
senses.exampleCN: 那片冰下的热液喷口可能支持生命。
senses.why: the conditions are defined by physics rather than by Earth, so planetary science reuses the term for alien oceans.
senses.whyCN: 这些条件由物理而非地球决定，因此行星科学把这个词用于外星海洋。

intro.en: Hydrothermal vent joins a Greek-rooted adjective to an English noun of Latin origin. Vent goes back through Old French to Latin ventus 'wind', whose sense shifted from moving air to the hole it blows through. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: hydrothermal vent 把希腊词根的形容词接在一个拉丁语源的英语名词上。vent 经古法语上溯拉丁 ventus「风」，词义从流动的空气转为它吹过的孔洞。年代均为约数。

items.en: Ventus meant 'wind'; Old French vent carried both 'wind' and 'opening for air', and English borrowed the latter.
items.cn: ventus 意为「风」；古法语 vent 兼有「风」与「通气口」两义，英语借入的是后者。

items.en: Hydro- and thermal come from Greek hydor 'water' and therme 'heat', joined in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: hydro- 与 thermal 来自希腊 hydor「水」与 therme「热」，于十九世纪合成。

items.en: The phrase hydrothermal vent was assembled in the late twentieth century once seafloor hot springs were directly observed.
items.cn: 海底热泉被直接观测到之后，hydrothermal vent 这一短语才在二十世纪后期组合起来。

items.en: Sailors' slang for a smoky funnel was borrowed for the dark chimneys, producing the informal synonym black smoker.
items.cn: 水手把冒烟的烟囱称作黑烟囱，这一俚语被借来形容深色喷口，产生了非正式同义词 black smoker。

items.en: The discovery of vent communities in 1977 made the phrase a biological term as well as a geological one.
items.cn: 一九七七年喷口生物群落的发现，使这个短语同时成为生物学术语。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the two elements are secure, but the earliest use of the exact phrase is not fixed in reference works.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代存疑）：两个成分都可靠，但这一确切短语的最早使用在各类工具书中并无定论。

note.en: Group one holds the vent types and related discharge features that are routinely confused; group two holds the general words for an opening or a spring.
note.cn: 第一组是常被混淆的喷口类型与相关排放地貌；第二组是泛指开口或泉的词语。

entries.definition: A very hot vent whose fluid precipitates dark metal sulphides; it is a kind of hydrothermal vent, not a separate thing.
entries.definitionCN: 流体沉淀出深色金属硫化物的极热喷口；它是热液喷口的一种，并非另类事物。

entries.definition: A cooler vent whose fluid precipitates pale silica and barytes rather than dark sulphides.
entries.definitionCN: 温度较低的喷口，流体沉淀浅色硅质与重晶石，而非深色硫化物。

entries.definition: A seafloor seep of cold, often methane-rich fluid; it lacks the high temperature that defines a hydrothermal vent.
entries.definitionCN: 低温且常富含甲烷的海底渗漏；缺少定义热液喷口所需的高温。

entries.definition: A cluster of vents and deposits in one area; a single opening is a vent, not a field.
entries.definitionCN: 同一区域的一组喷口与沉积；单个开口是喷口，不是热液场。

entries.definition: Any opening for air, gas or liquid; alone it says nothing about temperature or the sea.
entries.definitionCN: 任何供气、气或液体通过的开口；单用时不涉及温度或海洋。

entries.definition: A natural flow of water from the ground; it is usually on land and usually cool.
entries.definitionCN: 水从地下自然流出；通常在陆上，通常温度不高。

entries.definition: A slow, spreading flow through pores or small cracks; it stresses gradual leakage, not forceful discharge.
entries.definitionCN: 经孔隙或小裂缝缓慢扩散的流动；强调渐渗，而非猛烈喷出。

entries.definition: The rising cloud carried away from the opening; it is the product of a vent, not the vent itself.
entries.definitionCN: 从开口被带走的上升云团；它是喷口的产物，不是喷口本身。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real compounds, real vent types and real physical steps, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的复合词、真实的喷口类型与真实的物理步骤，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: hydrothermal is water plus heat; vent is an opening: the phrase is a hot-water opening.
normal.cn: hydrothermal 是水加热，vent 是开口：这个短语就是「热水的开口」。

normal.en: Dark smoke means dark ore: black smokers precipitate sulphides, white smokers precipitate silica.
normal.cn: 深色的烟意味着深色的矿：黑烟囱沉淀硫化物，白烟囱沉淀硅质。

normal.en: A vent is hot, a seep is cold: the two words divide seafloor discharge by temperature.
normal.cn: 喷口是热的，渗漏是冷的：两个词按温度划分海底排放。

normal.en: The chimney is made by the vent itself, layer by layer, where hot meets cold.
normal.cn: 烟囱是喷口自己在热水遇冷处一层层造出来的。

normal.en: No sunlight, no problem: the community runs on sulphides through chemosynthesis.
normal.cn: 没有阳光也没关系：这个群落靠硫化物进行化能合成。

abstract.en: A vent is a wound in the seafloor that keeps talking.
abstract.cn: 喷口是海底的一道伤口，一直在说话。

abstract.en: It is a chimney with no fire below, only stone and hot water arguing.
abstract.cn: 它是一座下面没有火的烟囱，只有石头与热水在争论。

abstract.en: Life here begins with chemistry instead of dawn.
abstract.cn: 这里的生命以化学开始，而不是以黎明开始。

examples.en: The submersible filmed a hydrothermal vent at two thousand metres.
examples.cn: 深潜器在两千公尺处拍摄到一处热液喷口。

examples.en: Each hydrothermal vent hosts its own community of worms and clams.
examples.cn: 每个热液喷口都养育着自己的一套蠕虫与蛤类群落。

examples.en: The hydrothermal vent built a chimney of metal sulphides.
examples.cn: 这个热液喷口用金属硫化物筑起一座烟囱。

dict_mnemonic.text: hydrothermal（热液的）+ vent（出口）＝热液喷口；热水从海底裂缝冲出，遇冷沉淀成烟囱，养活靠化学能的生命。

root: hydrothermal（希腊 hydor「水」+ therme「热」）+ vent（拉丁 ventus「风」，义转为出风口）；短语为二十世纪后期地质学所立。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one opening: the hole, the plume, the chimney, the community it feeds, its place in a circuit, its fossil ore, its plume as a survey signature, and its analogue on icy moons.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个开口展开：洞口、羽流、烟囱、它供养的群落、它在循环中的位置、它化成的矿、作为探测信号的羽流，以及冰卫星上的类比。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a crack in the seafloor sending a hot dark jet into cold water.
core.cn: 核心意象：海底一道裂缝，把滚烫的深色水柱送进冷水里。

branches.en: HOLE AND JET: the opening, then what comes out of it.
branches.cn: 洞口与射流：先是开口，再是从中出来的东西。

branches.en: BUILT TOWER: precipitation turns the opening into a structure.
branches.cn: 堆成的塔：沉淀把开口变成构造。

branches.en: COMMUNITY AND CIRCUIT: what lives there, and where the outlet sits in the loop.
branches.cn: 群落与循环：那里住着什么，以及出口在环流中的位置。

branches.en: ORE AND SIGNATURE: a fossil vent becomes a mine, a plume becomes a clue.
branches.cn: 矿与信号：化石喷口变成矿，羽流变成线索。

branches.en: ALIEN ANALOGUE: the same opening imagined under another world's ice.
branches.cn: 外星类比：同一个开口被想象在另一个天体的冰下。

intro.en: Hydrothermal vent combines a Greek-rooted adjective with a short English noun, so the phrase is morphologically transparent at both ends.
intro.cn: hydrothermal vent 把希腊词根的形容词与一个简短英语名词组合，短语两端在构词上都透明。

latinIntro.en: Hydrothermal contributes no Latin entry; vent does, through Latin ventus 'wind'. The two halves come from different language families.
latinIntro.cn: hydrothermal 不提供拉丁条目；vent 则经拉丁 ventus「风」提供。两半来自不同语系。

items.example: Hydro- opens the adjective hydrothermal.
items.exampleCN: hydro- 是形容词 hydrothermal 的开头。

items.example: Therme supplies thermal and thermometer.
items.exampleCN: therme 提供 thermal 与 thermometer。

items.structure: ventus, venti (Latin noun, masculine, fourth declension)
items.example: Ventus gave French vent and English vent.
items.exampleCN: ventus 给出法语 vent 与英语 vent。

items.structure: vent (English noun from Old French vent)
items.meaning: an opening for air or fluid
items.meaningCN: 供空气或流体通过的开口
items.example: Steam escaped through a vent.
items.exampleCN: 蒸汽从一个排气口逸出。

items.meaning: relating to hot water in rock
items.example: Hydrothermal fluid altered the rock.
items.exampleCN: 热液改变了岩石。

items.example: The hydrothermal vent discharges sulphides.
items.exampleCN: 这个热液喷口排出硫化物。

items.meaning: a hot vent with dark precipitate
items.meaningCN: 沉淀物呈深色的高温喷口
items.example: The black smoker chimney stood three metres high.
items.exampleCN: 黑烟囱立起三米高。

items.meaning: a cooler vent with pale precipitate
items.meaningCN: 沉淀物呈浅色的较低温喷口
items.example: A white smoker stood beside the black one.
items.exampleCN: 一座白烟囱立在黑烟囱旁边。

items.example: Methane supports life at the cold seep.
items.exampleCN: 甲烷在冷泉处供养生命。

items.example: The plume drifted west from the vent.
items.exampleCN: 羽流从喷口向西飘去。

definition_zh: 海洋沉积物；海相沉积（堆积在海底的泥沙、生物残骸与化学沉淀）
definition_en: material deposited on the seafloor, including eroded rock debris, remains of organisms and chemical precipitates
core_image: 海底一层层细泥与贝壳碎片缓慢落下，越往下越压得紧实，像一本合上的厚书
scene: 钻探船把长管插进海底，提起一段层理分明的泥柱。Layers of marine sediment record millions of years of ocean history.
sceneCN: 这里 marine sediment 指「堆积在海底的沉积物」（第 1 个义项：覆盖海底的整体沉积物）；句意为层层海洋沉积物记录了数百万年的海洋历史。

pos.zh: 海洋沉积物；海相沉积（不可数，指不同来源时可用复数 marine sediments）

derivatives.zh: marinus（拉丁「海的」）→ 海的、海生的、海洋的
sedimentum（拉丁「沉淀物」，源自 sedere「坐下」）→ 沉积物；使沉淀
sediment + -ary（形容词后缀）→ 沉积形成的：沉积岩的
sediment + -ation（动作或结果）→ 沉积作用：颗粒沉降堆积的过程
sediment + -o- + -logy（学科后缀）→ 沉积学：研究沉积物与沉积岩的学科

senses.title: The seafloor deposit as a whole
senses.definition: the aggregate of loose material covering the seafloor
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖海底的松散物质总体
senses.example: Layers of marine sediment record millions of years of ocean history.
senses.exampleCN: 层层海洋沉积物记录了数百万年的海洋历史。
senses.why: marine fixes the setting and sediment fixes the material, so the phrase names whatever has settled on the seafloor.
senses.whyCN: marine 限定环境，sediment 限定材料，短语因此命名一切沉降到海底的东西。

senses.title: Land-derived debris
senses.definition: sand, silt and clay eroded from land and carried into the sea
senses.definitionCN: 从陆地侵蚀而来、被带入海洋的砂、粉砂与黏土
senses.example: River floods deliver coarse marine sediment to the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 河流洪水把粗粒海洋沉积物送到大陆架。
senses.why: most seafloor material starts as rock on land, so the phrase often refers specifically to that eroded fraction.
senses.whyCN: 海底物质大多起于陆上岩石，因此这个短语常特指那部分被侵蚀的碎屑。

senses.title: Remains of marine organisms
senses.definition: shells, tests and soft parts of organisms that accumulate as ooze
senses.definitionCN: 以软泥形式堆积的生物贝壳、壳体与软组织
senses.example: Calcareous marine sediment is made of tiny shell debris.
senses.exampleCN: 钙质海洋沉积物由微小贝壳碎屑构成。
senses.why: in the open ocean, the dominant supply is not land but the shells of plankton falling from above.
senses.whyCN: 在开阔海洋，主要供给不是陆地，而是自上落下的浮游生物壳。

senses.title: Chemical precipitates
senses.definition: minerals formed by chemical reaction or precipitation in seawater
senses.definitionCN: 在海水中经化学反应或沉淀形成的矿物
senses.example: Manganese nodules grow within marine sediment.
senses.exampleCN: 锰结核在海洋沉积物中生长。
senses.why: seawater itself can deposit solids, so the phrase also covers material that was never a particle of rock or shell.
senses.whyCN: 海水本身也能沉淀固体，因此这个短语也涵盖从未是岩石或贝壳颗粒的物质。

senses.title: A layered archive
senses.definition: the stratified sequence read as a record of past conditions
senses.definitionCN: 作为过去环境记录来解读的层状序列
senses.example: The marine sediment sequence spans the last ice age.
senses.exampleCN: 这段海洋沉积层序跨越上一个冰期。
senses.why: deposition is ordered in time, so the pile becomes readable from bottom to top.
senses.whyCN: 沉积按时间排序，因此这堆物质可以从下往上阅读。

senses.title: A size and rate signal
senses.definition: the grain size and accumulation rate used to infer current strength and supply
senses.definitionCN: 用来推断水流强度与供给量的粒径与堆积速率
senses.example: Coarse marine sediment points to a strong bottom current.
senses.exampleCN: 粗粒海洋沉积物指向强劲的底层流。
senses.why: fast water carries coarse grains and slow water drops fine ones, so texture records the flow.
senses.whyCN: 快水搬运粗颗粒，慢水只落细颗粒，因此质地记录了流动。

senses.title: A sampling target
senses.definition: the material recovered in cores and grabs for study
senses.definitionCN: 用岩芯管与抓斗取出供研究的材料
senses.example: The core brought up two metres of marine sediment.
senses.exampleCN: 岩芯管取上两米海洋沉积物。
senses.why: the phrase names both the deposit and the object a ship actually recovers, which is how field scientists use it.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语既命名沉积层，也命名船上实际取回的物件，野外科学家正是这样使用。

senses.title: A foundation material
senses.definition: the deposit considered for its strength and stability under structures
senses.definitionCN: 从结构与稳定性角度考虑的沉积层
senses.example: Engineers tested the marine sediment before building the platform.
senses.exampleCN: 工程师在建造平台前测试了这片海洋沉积物。
senses.why: loose seafloor material bears loads and can liquefy, so engineering treats it as a material with properties.
senses.whyCN: 松散海底物质要承受荷载也可能液化，因此工程学把它当作有性质的材料。

intro.en: Marine sediment joins a Latin adjective to a Latin noun. Marine derives from mare 'sea' through marinus; sediment derives from sedimentum 'a settling', from sedere 'to sit'. The phrase is English, but every element is Latin. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: marine sediment 把拉丁形容词接在拉丁名词上。marine 经 marinus 来自 mare「海」；sediment 来自 sedimentum「沉降物」，再上溯 sedere「坐下」。短语是英语，但每个成分都是拉丁语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Mare 'sea' produced marinus 'of the sea', which French and English shortened into the adjective marine.
items.cn: mare「海」产生 marinus「海的」，法语与英语再把它简化为形容词 marine。

items.en: Sedere meant 'to sit, to settle'; its participle formed sedimentum, literally 'that which has settled'.
items.cn: sedere 意为「坐、沉降」；其分词构成 sedimentum，字面就是「已经沉下来的东西」。

items.en: Sediment entered English in the seventeenth century as a general word for matter that settles in liquid.
items.cn: sediment 于十七世纪进入英语，泛指在液体中沉降的物质。

items.en: As geology developed, sediment was extended from laboratory settling to rock debris laid down by water, wind and ice.
items.cn: 随着地质学发展，sediment 从实验室沉淀扩展到水、风与冰堆积的岩石碎屑。

items.en: Deep-sea coring in the twentieth century made marine sediment a standard term for the seafloor's layered cover.
items.cn: 二十世纪的深海取芯使 marine sediment 成为海底层状覆盖物的标准术语。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the phrase's earliest technical citation is not consistently dated, though both words are securely documented.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代存疑）：这个短语最早的技术书证各家年代不一，尽管两个词本身记载可靠。

note.en: Group one holds the sediment terms most often mixed up with marine sediment; group two holds the general words for material that settles.
note.cn: 第一组是常与 marine sediment 混淆的沉积术语；第二组是泛指沉降物质的词。

entries.definition: Rock formed from compacted sediment; marine sediment is the loose material before that hardening.
entries.definitionCN: 由沉积物压实形成的岩石；marine sediment 是压实之前的松散材料。

entries.definition: Any material laid down in the sea, including chemical and volcanic kinds; it is broader than the usual sandy meaning of sediment.
entries.definitionCN: 在海洋中堆积的任何物质，包括化学与火山来源；比通常偏砂泥含义的 sediment 更宽。

entries.definition: A deep-sea deposit made mainly of plankton remains; it is one type of marine sediment, not the whole category.
entries.definitionCN: 主要由浮游生物遗骸构成的深海沉积；它是海洋沉积物的一种，不是整个类别。

entries.definition: Soft wet earth or clay; it can be on land, and it lacks the marine setting and the geological scope.
entries.definitionCN: 柔软潮湿的土或黏土；可以在陆上，缺少海洋环境与地质范围。

entries.definition: Material that settles in water or wind; it needs no marine qualifier and may be found in rivers or lakes.
entries.definitionCN: 在水或风中沉降的物质；无需海洋限定，也可出现在河流或湖泊中。

entries.definition: A mass of material that has accumulated, including ore and volcanic layers; it is broader and less textural than sediment.
entries.definitionCN: 已经堆积的一团物质，包括矿体与火山层；比 sediment 更宽，也更不强调质地。

entries.definition: Fine particles between sand and clay; it is a size class within sediment, not a setting.
entries.definitionCN: 介于砂与黏土之间的细颗粒；它是沉积物中的粒径等级，不是环境。

entries.definition: Scattered fragments of rock or other material; it stresses breakage rather than settling.
entries.definitionCN: 散落的岩石或其他材料碎块；强调破碎，而非沉降。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin roots, real grain sizes and real deep-sea terms, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词根、真实的粒径与真实的深海术语，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: sedere means sit: sediment is what has sat down out of the water.
normal.cn: sedere 意为坐：sediment 就是从水里坐下来的东西。

normal.en: marinus means of the sea: marine marks the setting, sediment marks the material.
normal.cn: marinus 意为海的：marine 标环境，sediment 标材料。

normal.en: Three sources: land debris, plankton shells, chemical precipitate.
normal.cn: 三种来源：陆地碎屑、浮游生物壳、化学沉淀。

normal.en: Grain size order runs clay, silt, sand, gravel, and the size tells the current.
normal.cn: 粒径次序是黏土、粉砂、砂、砾，粒径告诉水流强弱。

normal.en: A core is a library: each centimetre is a page of ocean history.
normal.cn: 岩芯是一座图书馆：每一厘米都是海洋历史的一页。

abstract.en: Marine sediment is the ocean writing its diary in falling dust.
abstract.cn: 海洋沉积物是海洋用落下的尘写下日记。

abstract.en: The seafloor is a slow budget: what land loses, the deep receives.
abstract.cn: 海底是一本缓慢的账：陆地失去的，深海收下。

abstract.en: Every shell that sinks is a letter posted from the sunlit layer to the dark.
abstract.cn: 每一枚下沉的贝壳，都是从阳光层寄往黑暗层的一封信。

examples.en: The core sample contained marine sediment from the last glacial period.
examples.cn: 岩芯样品中含有上个冰期的海洋沉积物。

examples.en: Marine sediment on the slope is unstable after heavy storms.
examples.cn: 大风暴之后，斜坡上的海洋沉积物不稳定。

examples.en: Chemists analysed marine sediment for traces of ancient pollution.
examples.cn: 化学家分析海洋沉积物中的古代污染痕迹。

dict_mnemonic.text: marine（海的）+ sediment（沉降物）＝海底沉下来的东西；陆上碎屑、生物壳、化学沉淀三路来源，一层层压成档案。

root: marine（拉丁 mare「海」→ marinus「海的」）+ sediment（拉丁 sedimentum「沉降物」，源自 sedere「坐下」）；短语为英语，成分全为拉丁语源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one settling: the whole cover, its land and biological and chemical sources, its layering, its texture, its sampling, and its behaviour as ground.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一次沉降展开：整个覆盖层、它的陆源与生物与化学来源、它的层序、它的质地、它的采样，以及它作为地基的表现。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: fine particles falling through dark water and stacking into layers on the seafloor.
core.cn: 核心意象：细颗粒穿过深水落下，在海底堆成一层层。

branches.en: THE COVER AND LAND SOURCE: the whole blanket, then the eroded rock that feeds it.
branches.cn: 覆盖层与陆源：先是整张毯子，再是供养它的侵蚀碎屑。

branches.en: SHELL AND CHEMISTRY: plankton remains and precipitates join the pile.
branches.cn: 贝壳与化学：浮游生物遗骸与沉淀加入堆积。

branches.en: TIME AND TEXTURE: layers record time, grain size records flow.
branches.cn: 时间与质地：层记录时间，粒径记录流动。

branches.en: SAMPLE: what the core brings up is the same material made portable.
branches.cn: 样品：岩芯取上来的正是同一种材料，只是变得可携带。

branches.en: GROUND: the pile is also a material that must hold weight.
branches.cn: 地基：这堆物质也是必须承重的材料。

intro.en: Marine sediment is a two-word technical phrase in which both halves are Latin borrowings with productive English families.
intro.cn: marine sediment 是两词技术短语，两半都是拉丁借词，且在英语中有能产的词族。

latinIntro.en: Mare gives marine, mariner and maritime; sedere gives sediment, sedentary and session. The roots are different: sea and sitting.
latinIntro.cn: mare 衍生 marine、mariner 与 maritime；sedere 衍生 sediment、sedentary 与 session。两个词根不同：一为海，一为坐。

items.structure: mare, maris (Latin noun, neuter, third declension)
items.example: Mare supplied the adjective marinus.
items.exampleCN: mare 提供了形容词 marinus。

items.example: Marinus became English marine.
items.exampleCN: marinus 变成英语 marine。

items.structure: sedere, sedi, sessum (Latin verb, second conjugation)
items.example: Sedere is the verb behind sediment.
items.exampleCN: sedere 是 sediment 背后的动词。

items.structure: sedimentum, sedimenti (Latin noun, neuter, second declension)
items.example: Sedimentum named what had settled in wine.
items.exampleCN: sedimentum 原指酒中沉下的东西。

items.example: Sediment filled the harbour.
items.exampleCN: 沉积物填满了港湾。

items.example: Sedimentary layers lie beneath the plain.
items.exampleCN: 沉积层位于平原之下。

items.example: Sedimentation buried the wreck.
items.exampleCN: 沉积作用掩埋了沉船。

items.example: Marine life depends on sunlight.
items.exampleCN: 海洋生命依赖阳光。

items.example: Marine sediment covers the abyssal plain.
items.exampleCN: 海洋沉积物覆盖着深海平原。

items.meaningCN: 浮游生物遗骸构成的深海软泥
items.example: Biogenic ooze is a kind of marine sediment.
items.exampleCN: 生物软泥是海洋沉积物的一种。

definition_zh: 海带；大型褐藻（尤指成片生长于冷水岩岸的海带类海藻）
definition_en: a large brown seaweed that grows in dense stands along cool rocky coasts
core_image: 退潮后的礁石上垂着一片片宽厚的褐色长叶，随水摆动，像一条被海水浸透的森林
scene: 清晨的冷水海岸，退潮后露出一整片浓密的褐色藻带。Kelp grows in dense forests along cool rocky coasts.
sceneCN: 这里 kelp 指「海带类大型褐藻」（第 1 个义项：植物本身，而非藻场或产品）；句意为海带在寒冷的岩岸长成浓密的森林。

pos.zh: 海带；大型褐藻（多作不可数名词，指数种时复数 kelps）

derivatives.zh: kelp（海带）+ forest（森林，借自拉丁 forestis「林外的」）→ 海带林：由大型褐藻构成的水下森林
kelp + bed（床、底层）→ 海带藻场：海带附着生长的成片海底
kelp + ash（灰，古英语 asce）→ 海藻灰：焚烧海带得到的含碱灰烬，曾用于制玻璃与制皂
kelp + -y（形容词后缀）→ 海带般的：沾满海藻的、有海带味的

senses.title: The brown seaweed itself
senses.definition: a large brown alga of the order Laminariales
senses.definitionCN: 褐藻纲海带目的大型藻类
senses.example: Kelp grows in dense forests along cool rocky coasts.
senses.exampleCN: 海带在寒冷的岩岸长成浓密的森林。
senses.why: kelp is a mass noun for the plant, and the word covers several large brown species rather than one.
senses.whyCN: kelp 是这类植物的集合名词，涵盖数种大型褐藻，而非单一物种。

senses.title: A kelp forest
senses.titleCN: 海带林：成片的水下藻场
senses.definition: a dense underwater stand formed by tall kelp
senses.definitionCN: 由高大海带形成的水下密集群体
senses.example: A kelp forest shelters juvenile fish along the reef.
senses.exampleCN: 一片海带林为礁边的幼鱼提供庇护。
senses.why: kelp grows in stands tall enough to form a canopy, so the word also names the habitat those stands create.
senses.whyCN: 海带长得足以形成冠层，因此这个词也命名这些群体造就的栖息环境。

senses.title: The individual plant body
senses.definition: one plant with its holdfast, stipe and fronds
senses.definitionCN: 一株带固着器、柄与叶片的植物
senses.example: Each kelp anchors itself with a branching holdfast.
senses.exampleCN: 每一株海带都用分枝的固着器固定自己。
senses.why: the mass noun also has a count use for a single plant, because each one is a clearly bounded individual.
senses.whyCN: 这个集合名词也有可数用法指单株，因为每一株都是边界清楚的个体。

senses.title: The harvested crop
senses.definition: kelp gathered commercially as a crop
senses.definitionCN: 作为作物被商业采收的海带
senses.example: The farm harvests kelp twice a year.
senses.exampleCN: 这个养殖场一年采收两次海带。
senses.why: once people cut and sell it, kelp becomes a crop and takes on the vocabulary of agriculture.
senses.whyCN: 一旦人们收割并出售它，海带就成为作物，带上农业词汇。

senses.title: A food and supplement
senses.definition: kelp eaten as food or used as a mineral supplement
senses.definitionCN: 作为食物食用或作为矿物质补充剂使用的海带
senses.example: Dried kelp adds iodine and savoury flavour to soup.
senses.exampleCN: 干海带为汤增加碘与鲜味。
senses.why: because the plant concentrates iodine from seawater, it entered cuisine and later nutrition as a supplement.
senses.whyCN: 由于这种植物从海水中富集碘，它进入烹饪，后来又成为营养补充品。

senses.title: Kelp ash as an industrial material
senses.definition: the alkaline ash of burnt kelp, once used in glass and soap making
senses.definitionCN: 焚烧海带所得的碱性灰，曾用于制玻璃与制皂
senses.example: Coastal villages once exported kelp ash for soap works.
senses.exampleCN: 沿海村庄曾向制皂厂出口海藻灰。
senses.why: burning kelp leaves soda-rich ash, so the word also names that processed product in older industry.
senses.whyCN: 焚烧海带留下富碱的灰，因此这个词在旧工业中也命名那种加工产品。

senses.title: An ecosystem engineer
senses.definition: the species considered for the habitat and food web it builds
senses.definitionCN: 从它构建的栖息环境与食物网角度考虑的物种
senses.example: Kelp supports hundreds of species along this coast.
senses.exampleCN: 海带供养着这片海岸的数百个物种。
senses.why: a stand changes light, flow and shelter, so ecology treats kelp as a builder rather than only a plant.
senses.whyCN: 一片藻带改变光照、水流与庇护条件，因此生态学把海带视为建造者，而不只是植物。

senses.title: A carbon and nutrient store
senses.definition: the biomass considered as a store of carbon and nutrients
senses.definitionCN: 作为碳与养分储存来看的生物量
senses.example: Kelp exports carbon to deep water when it breaks loose.
senses.exampleCN: 海带脱落后把碳输出到深水。
senses.why: fast-growing kelp takes up carbon and then exports it when fronds break away, so the word gains a climate sense.
senses.whyCN: 快速生长的海带吸收碳，叶片脱落后又把碳输出，因此这个词获得气候义。

intro.en: Kelp is an English word first recorded in Scottish sources, and its origin is genuinely unsettled. It is not a Latin borrowing. Dates are approximate and the deeper source is unknown.
intro.cn: kelp 是英语词，最早见于苏格兰文献，其来源确实没有定论，并非拉丁借词。年代均为约数，更深来源不明。

items.en: Kelp appears in seventeenth-century Scottish writing for large seaweed, especially the kind burned for ash.
items.cn: kelp 于十七世纪苏格兰文献中出现，指大型海藻，尤指焚烧取灰的那种。

items.en: Source uncertain: no agreed etymology exists. Suggestions link it to Scandinavian or Old English words for a stem or a jaw-like shape, but none is demonstrated.
items.cn: 来源不确定：没有公认的词源。有说法把它联系到斯堪的纳维亚语或古英语中表示茎、颚状物的词，但均未获证实。

items.en: From the eighteenth century kelp meant the ash of burned seaweed, an alkali source for glass and soap before synthetic soda.
items.cn: 从十八世纪起，kelp 指焚烧海藻所得的灰，是合成纯碱出现之前玻璃与制皂的碱源。

items.en: Nineteenth-century naturalists applied the word to the living brown algae themselves rather than only to the ash.
items.cn: 十九世纪博物学家把这个词用于活的褐藻本身，而不只是灰。

items.en: Twentieth-century diving and ecology gave the compound kelp forest, naming the underwater stand as a habitat.
items.cn: 二十世纪的潜水与生态学造出复合词 kelp forest，把水下藻带命名成一种栖息环境。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only as well): references differ on the earliest citation, and the pre-Scottish history of the word is simply not recorded.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代亦存疑）：各类工具书对最早书证的年代不一致，而这个词在苏格兰语之前的历史没有记载。

note.en: Group one holds the seaweed terms most often mistaken for kelp; group two holds the broader biological words for sea plants.
note.cn: 第一组是常被误认作 kelp 的海藻术语；第二组是泛指海藻的生物学词语。

entries.definition: The dense underwater stand formed by tall kelp; it is a place and a community, while kelp is the organism.
entries.definitionCN: 由高大海带形成的水下密集群体；它是地点与群落，而 kelp 是生物本身。

entries.definition: A patch of kelp attached to the bottom, often smaller and less canopy-forming than a kelp forest.
entries.definitionCN: 附着海底的一片海带，通常比海带林小，冠层也不明显。

entries.definition: A general word for any large marine alga, green, red or brown; kelp is only the brown, large kind.
entries.definitionCN: 泛指任何大型海藻，包括绿藻、红藻与褐藻；kelp 只是其中大型的褐藻。

entries.definition: A brown seaweed of the upper shore, often found loose on the beach; it is not the deep kelp of cold rocky coasts.
entries.definitionCN: 潮间带上部的褐藻，常散落在海滩；并非冷水岩岸的深水海带。

entries.definition: The broad biological group of plant-like organisms without true roots or leaves; kelp is one family within it.
entries.definitionCN: 一大类没有真正根叶的类植物生物；海带是其中的一个科。

entries.definition: A flowering plant that grows in the sea, with true roots and flowers; kelp is an alga and has neither.
entries.definitionCN: 生长在海中的开花植物，有真正的根与花；海带是藻类，两者都没有。

entries.definition: A small flowerless land plant growing in damp places; it is not marine and not related to kelp.
entries.definitionCN: 生长在潮湿地的小型无花陆生植物；既非海生，也与海带无关。

entries.definition: A single very large species that builds tall canopies; kelp as a mass noun covers many species besides this one.
entries.definitionCN: 一种能形成高大冠层的巨藻；作为集合名词的 kelp 还涵盖其他许多种类。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real biology, real products and real coastal practice, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的生物学、真实的产品与真实的海岸生产，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Three parts of one plant: holdfast, stipe and frond, the anchor, the stem and the leaf.
normal.cn: 一株植物分三部分：固着器、柄与叶片，即锚、茎与叶。

normal.en: Kelp is brown and large; seaweed is any colour and any size.
normal.cn: kelp 是褐色且大型的；seaweed 可以是任何颜色与大小。

normal.en: Cold, rocky, moving water is the recipe: that is where kelp forests form.
normal.cn: 冷水、岩岸与流动的水是配方：海带林就长在那里。

normal.en: Kelp ash was the old chemical industry: burn the weed, sell the soda.
normal.cn: 海藻灰是旧的化学工业：烧掉海草，卖出纯碱。

normal.en: Kelp concentrates iodine, which is why it entered both cuisine and medicine.
normal.cn: 海带富集碘，因此它同时进入烹饪与医药。

abstract.en: A kelp forest is a city that anchors itself to stone and sways.
abstract.cn: 海带林是一座把自身锚在石头上、还会摇摆的城市。

abstract.en: Kelp is the coast's quick ledger: it grows fast, records the season, then lets go.
abstract.cn: 海带是海岸的速记账本：长得快，记下季节，然后放手。

abstract.en: It is a rope of seawater standing upright because light asks it to.
abstract.cn: 它是一条海水做的绳索，因为光的要求而直立。

examples.en: Giant kelp can grow half a metre in a single day.
examples.cn: 巨藻一天能长半米。

examples.en: The kelp harvest supports a small coastal industry.
examples.cn: 海带采收支撑着一项小型沿海产业。

examples.en: Storm waves tore the kelp from its holdfast.
examples.cn: 风暴浪把海带从固着器上撕了下来。

dict_mnemonic.text: kelp＝海带、大型褐藻；冷水岩岸成林，三部分是固着器、柄、叶片，烧成灰可制玻璃制皂。

root: 英语词，最早见于十七世纪苏格兰文献；词源无定论，可能来自斯堪的纳维亚语或古英语中表示茎、颚状物的词，均未证实；非拉丁语源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one brown alga: the plant, its forest, its body, its harvest, its food use, its ash, its ecological role and its carbon store.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种褐藻展开：植物本身、它的藻林、它的个体结构、它的采收、它的食用、它的灰、它的生态角色与它的碳储存。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: broad brown fronds hanging from rock at low tide, moving with the swell.
core.cn: 核心意象：退潮时宽厚的褐色叶片从礁石垂下，随涌浪摆动。

branches.en: PLANT AND BODY: the mass noun, then one anchored individual with its three parts.
branches.cn: 植物与个体：先是集合名词，再是一株有三大部位的固着个体。

branches.en: STAND AND ENGINEER: the forest it builds and the habitat that forest becomes.
branches.cn: 藻场与工程师：它建起的林，以及那片林变成的栖息地。

branches.en: CROP AND FOOD: harvest, then kitchen and supplement.
branches.cn: 作物与食物：先是采收，再到厨房与补充剂。

branches.en: ASH: burning turns the plant into an industrial alkali.
branches.cn: 灰：焚烧把植物变成工业碱料。

branches.en: CARBON STORE: biomass and its export to deep water.
branches.cn: 碳库：生物量及它向深水的输出。

intro.en: Kelp is an underived English noun with no productive affix of its own; its family is built entirely from compounds formed with other free words.
intro.cn: kelp 是不带派生词缀的英语名词，本身没有能产词缀；它的词族全部由与其他自由词构成的复合词组成。

latinIntro.en: Kelp has no Latin ancestry and no Latin cognate; the Latin word alga 'seaweed' belongs to a different root and is not related.
latinIntro.cn: kelp 没有拉丁语祖先，也没有拉丁同族词；拉丁 alga「海藻」属另一词根，与它无关。

items.example: Kelp covered the rocks at low tide.
items.exampleCN: 退潮时海带覆盖着礁石。

items.meaning: the root-like anchor of a seaweed
items.meaningCN: 海藻用来固着的根状结构
items.example: The holdfast gripped the boulder.
items.exampleCN: 固着器紧紧抓住巨石。

items.example: A long stipe lifts the fronds toward light.
items.exampleCN: 长长的柄把叶片举向光。

items.meaning: the leaf-like blade of a seaweed
items.example: Each frond can be two metres long.
items.exampleCN: 每片叶状体可长达两米。

items.example: Fish hide in the kelp bed.
items.exampleCN: 鱼藏在海带藻场里。

items.meaning: a tall underwater stand of kelp
items.example: The kelp forest reaches the surface.
items.exampleCN: 海带林一直伸到水面。

items.meaningCN: 焚烧海带所得的碱性灰
items.example: Kelp ash was sold to glassmakers.
items.exampleCN: 海藻灰被卖给玻璃匠。

items.meaning: covered with or tasting of kelp
items.meaningCN: 覆满海带的；有海带味的
items.example: The rocks were kelpy and slippery.
items.exampleCN: 礁石覆满海带，十分滑。

items.meaning: brown weed of the upper shore
items.example: Wrack lay in lines along the beach.
items.exampleCN: 海草在海滩上排成一条条线。

items.example: Seaweed floated in the shallow bay.
items.exampleCN: 海藻漂在浅湾里。

definition_zh: 环礁；珊瑚环礁（由珊瑚礁围成环形、中间包着潟湖的海岛）
definition_en: a ring-shaped coral reef enclosing a shallow lagoon, often with low islets on the rim
core_image: 海面上一圈细细的白浪围住一片浅蓝，圈外是深蓝，圈内是平静的浅水
scene: 飞机下降时，海面浮出一圈白色浪线，中间围着一片浅蓝水面。Below them an atoll ringed a shallow lagoon.
sceneCN: 这里 atoll 指「环形珊瑚礁及其围合的整体」（第 1 个义项：作为完整地貌单位的环礁）；句意为他们下方的一座环礁围着一片浅潟湖。

pos.zh: 环礁；珊瑚环礁（可数，复数 atolls）

derivatives.zh: atoll（环礁）+ lagoon（潟湖，意大利 laguna ← 拉丁 lacuna「水池」）→ 环礁潟湖：环礁围出的浅水区
atoll + reef（礁，古诺斯语 rif「脊」）→ 环礁礁体：构成环形的珊瑚礁带
cay（小沙岛，源自西班牙语 cayo，可能上溯加勒比语）→ 环礁礁缘上的低矮沙洲
atoll + -like（类似……的）→ 环礁状的：形状像环礁的

senses.title: A ring-shaped reef
senses.titleCN: 环形礁体：围合的整体地貌
senses.definition: a coral reef forming a closed or nearly closed ring
senses.definitionCN: 形成闭合或近于闭合环形的珊瑚礁
senses.example: Below them an atoll ringed a shallow lagoon.
senses.exampleCN: 他们下方的一座环礁围着一片浅潟湖。
senses.why: the word names the whole ring, not one part of it, because the ring is what makes the feature recognisable from the air.
senses.whyCN: 这个词命名整个环，而非其中一部分，因为从空中辨认靠的正是这个环。

senses.title: The reef rim
senses.definition: the outer edge of the reef where waves break
senses.definitionCN: 礁体迎浪的外缘，即白浪破碎处
senses.example: Surf broke along the atoll rim all night.
senses.exampleCN: 整夜都有浪沿着环礁礁缘破碎。
senses.why: the rim is the part that meets the open ocean, so the word is used for the outer edge as well as for the whole ring.
senses.whyCN: 礁缘是与外海相接的部分，因此这个词也指外缘，而不只指整个环。

senses.title: The enclosed lagoon
senses.titleCN: 环内潟湖：被围住的浅水
senses.definition: the shallow water enclosed by the ring
senses.definitionCN: 被环礁围住的浅水区
senses.example: The atoll holds a lagoon barely ten metres deep.
senses.exampleCN: 这座环礁围出一个不足十米深的潟湖。
senses.why: the ring exists by enclosing something, so the enclosed water is treated as part of the atoll's description.
senses.whyCN: 环的意义在于围住什么，因此被围的水也被视为环礁描述的一部分。

senses.title: Islets on the rim
senses.definition: low sandy islets built on parts of the reef
senses.definitionCN: 在礁体部分地段堆起的低矮沙岛
senses.example: Three islets rise only two metres above the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 环礁上的三座小岛只高出海面两米。
senses.why: sand and coral rubble collect on the rim, so the word also names the land that the reef carries.
senses.whyCN: 沙与珊瑚碎屑堆在礁缘，因此这个词也命名礁体承载的陆地。

senses.title: Formation by subsidence
senses.titleCN: 成因：火山基座沉降与珊瑚上长
senses.definition: the geological history in which a volcanic base subsides while coral grows upward
senses.definitionCN: 火山基座下沉、珊瑚向上生长所形成的地质历史
senses.example: Darwin explained the atoll by slow subsidence of a volcanic base.
senses.exampleCN: 达尔文用火山基座的缓慢沉降解释环礁的成因。
senses.why: the ring shape records a history: coral keeps building at the edge while the centre sinks.
senses.whyCN: 环形记录了一段历史：珊瑚在边缘持续建造，中央则在下沉。

senses.title: A human home
senses.titleCN: 人类居所：低岛上的生活
senses.definition: the land and water used as a home by island communities
senses.definitionCN: 被岛上社群当作居所的陆与水
senses.example: The atoll supports a fishing village of two hundred people.
senses.exampleCN: 这座环礁供养着一个两百人的渔村。
senses.why: a ring of islets with sheltered water is a practical place to live, so the word also names a human territory.
senses.whyCN: 一圈小岛加一片受护的水面是实用的居所，因此这个词也命名人类的地域。

senses.title: An ancient limestone body
senses.titleCN: 古环礁：抬升后的石灰岩体
senses.definition: a fossil atoll uplifted and exposed as limestone
senses.definitionCN: 被抬升出露、成为石灰岩的化石环礁
senses.example: The quarry cuts through an ancient atoll.
senses.exampleCN: 采石场切穿一座古环礁。
senses.why: when the seafloor rises, the reef becomes solid rock, and geology keeps the name for the fossil shape.
senses.whyCN: 海底抬升后礁体变成坚硬的岩石，地质学仍用这个词称呼那个化石形状。

senses.title: A low, exposed coast
senses.titleCN: 低洼而脆弱的环礁海岸
senses.definition: the atoll considered as a low-lying coast vulnerable to waves and rising sea
senses.definitionCN: 作为低洼、易受浪与海面上涨影响的环礁海岸
senses.example: Rising seas threaten every atoll in the region.
senses.exampleCN: 海面上涨威胁着这个地区的每一座环礁。
senses.why: the land sits only metres above the sea, so the word has become a shorthand for that vulnerability.
senses.whyCN: 陆地只高出海面数米，因此这个词已成为那种脆弱性的代称。

intro.en: Atoll entered English through French from Dhivehi, the language of the Maldives, where atolu names a reef ring. It has no Latin ancestry. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: atoll 经法语从马尔代夫的迪维希语进入英语，当地语 atolu 指环形礁。它没有拉丁语祖先。年代均为约数。

items.en: Atolu in Dhivehi named the ring reefs of the Maldive islands, a navigational fact long known to local sailors.
items.cn: 迪维希语 atolu 指马尔代夫群岛的环形礁，这是当地水手早已知晓的航行事实。

items.en: French naturalists adopted the word in the early nineteenth century as atoll, spelling it after their own conventions.
items.cn: 十九世纪初法国博物学家借入这个词作 atoll，并按法语习惯拼写。

items.en: English took atoll from French in the 1830s, at first only for the Maldive and Caroline rings.
items.cn: 英语于十九世纪三十年代从法语借入 atoll，最初只用于马尔代夫与加罗林群岛的环礁。

items.en: Darwin's subsidence theory of 1842 gave the word a geological definition and spread it through science.
items.cn: 达尔文一八四二年的沉降说赋予这个词地质定义，并使它在科学界传播。

items.en: Twentieth-century oceanography mapped atolls worldwide and added the climate sense of a low, exposed coast.
items.cn: 二十世纪海洋学测绘了全球环礁，并加入「低洼脆弱海岸」的气候义。

items.en: Source uncertain (deeper origin only): the pre-Dhivehi source of atolu is not established, and any Sanskrit or Indo-Aryan form offered for it is a reconstruction.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅更深词源存疑）：atolu 在迪维希语之前的来源无定论，凡为其给出的梵语或印度-雅利安语形式均属重构。

note.en: Group one holds the reef types routinely confused with an atoll; group two holds the general landform words nearby in meaning.
note.cn: 第一组是常与环礁混淆的礁类型；第二组是语义相近的一般地貌词。

entries.definition: A reef running parallel to a coast and separated from it by a lagoon; it does not close into a ring.
entries.definitionCN: 与海岸平行、被潟湖隔开的礁带；它并不闭合成环。

entries.definition: A reef growing directly along a coastline with no lagoon between it and the land.
entries.definitionCN: 紧贴海岸生长、与陆地之间没有潟湖的礁。

entries.definition: The shallow water enclosed by a reef or sandbar; an atoll contains a lagoon but is not one.
entries.definitionCN: 被礁或沙洲围住的浅水；环礁包含潟湖，但它本身不是潟湖。

entries.definition: A small low sandy island on a reef; it is one piece of an atoll's rim, not the whole ring.
entries.definitionCN: 礁上的低矮小沙岛；它只是环礁礁缘的一小段，不是整个环。

entries.definition: Any ridge of rock or coral near the surface; it need not form a ring and need not enclose water.
entries.definitionCN: 任何接近水面的岩脊或珊瑚脊；不必成环，也不必围住水。

entries.definition: A piece of land surrounded by water; it says nothing about coral or about a ring shape.
entries.definitionCN: 四周被水围住的陆地；不涉及珊瑚，也不涉及环形。

entries.definition: A group or chain of islands; it is a regional grouping, not a single ring reef.
entries.definitionCN: 一组或一串岛屿；它是区域性的岛群，不是单个环形礁。

entries.definition: A shallow area of sand or rock rising near the surface; it has no enclosing ring.
entries.definitionCN: 接近水面隆起的浅沙或浅岩区；没有围合的环。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real geography, real reef types and real formation steps, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的地貌、真实的礁类型与真实的形成步骤，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Atoll is a borrowed Pacific word, not a Latin one: the thing and the name travel together.
normal.cn: atoll 是借来的太平洋词汇，不是拉丁词：事物与名字一起传来。

normal.en: The shape is a ring: reef outside, lagoon inside, islets on the rim.
normal.cn: 形状是一个环：外面是礁，里面是潟湖，环上散着小岛。

normal.en: Formation order: volcano, fringing reef, barrier reef, atoll, as the base sinks.
normal.cn: 形成次序：火山、裙礁、堡礁、环礁，随基座下沉而演进。

normal.en: An atoll is not a lagoon: the atoll is the ring, the lagoon is the water inside it.
normal.cn: 环礁不是潟湖：环礁是那个环，潟湖是环里的水。

normal.en: Low elevation is the point: most atoll islets stand only a few metres above the sea.
normal.cn: 低海拔是关键：多数环礁小岛只高出海面几米。

abstract.en: An atoll is a reef that learned to draw a circle around its own disappearance.
abstract.cn: 环礁是一座学会围着自己消失之处画圈的礁。

abstract.en: It is a ring of stone keeping a shallow promise of safety.
abstract.cn: 它是一圈石头，守着一份浅浅的安全承诺。

abstract.en: The volcano is gone, and only its coral handwriting remains.
abstract.cn: 火山已经不在了，只剩它珊瑚写下的笔迹。

examples.en: The atoll is less than three metres above sea level at its highest point.
examples.cn: 这座环礁最高处不足海拔三米。

examples.en: Coral grew upward as the volcanic base of the atoll subsided.
examples.cn: 随着环礁的火山基座下沉，珊瑚向上生长。

examples.en: Fresh water lies in a thin lens beneath the atoll.
examples.cn: 环礁之下有一层薄薄的淡水透镜。

dict_mnemonic.text: atoll＝环礁；记成「一圈礁围着中间浅水」，成因是火山下沉、珊瑚上长，外面浪白，里面水静。

root: 借自迪维希语 atolu（环形礁），经法语 atoll 进入英语；无拉丁语源，迪维希语之前的来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one ring: the whole reef, its rim, its lagoon, its islets, its subsidence history, its human home, its fossil limestone body and its exposed coast.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个环展开：整圈礁、礁缘、潟湖、小岛、沉降历史、人类居所、化石石灰岩体与脆弱海岸。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thin white ring of breaking waves around a pale blue centre, with deep blue outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：一圈细白浪线围着一片浅蓝，圈外是深蓝。

branches.en: RING AND RIM: the whole circle, then the outer edge where waves break.
branches.cn: 环与缘：先是整个圈，再是迎浪的外缘。

branches.en: WATER AND LAND INSIDE: the enclosed lagoon, then the islets on the rim.
branches.cn: 圈内的水与陆：先是被围的潟湖，再是礁缘的小岛。

branches.en: HISTORY IN STONE: subsidence explains the ring, and uplift turns it into limestone.
branches.cn: 石中的历史：沉降解释环的形成，抬升又把它变成石灰岩。

branches.en: HUMAN HOME: the ring becomes a territory with a village and a fishery.
branches.cn: 人类居所：环变成有村庄与渔场的领地。

branches.en: LOW COAST: the same ring is now a measure of vulnerability.
branches.cn: 低海岸：同一个环如今成了脆弱性的尺度。

intro.en: Atoll is a single borrowed noun with no internal morphology; its related vocabulary comes from geography and other languages.
intro.cn: atoll 是单一借入名词，内部没有构词结构；它的相关词汇来自地理学与其他语言。

latinIntro.en: Atoll has no Latin entries. Latin insula 'island' and Greek korallion 'coral' describe the same setting from unrelated roots.
latinIntro.cn: atoll 没有拉丁条目。拉丁 insula「岛」与希腊 korallion「珊瑚」用无关词根描述同一环境。

items.structure: atoll (English noun from French, from Dhivehi atolu)
items.example: The atoll lies far from any continent.
items.exampleCN: 这座环礁远离任何大陆。

items.structure: reef (English noun, from Old Norse rif 'ridge')
items.example: The reef protects the shore from swell.
items.exampleCN: 礁保护海岸不受涌浪冲击。

items.structure: lagoon (English noun from Italian laguna, from Latin lacuna)
items.meaning: shallow water enclosed by reef or sand
items.example: The lagoon is calm at low tide.
items.exampleCN: 退潮时潟湖很平静。

items.example: A motu rises on the northern rim.
items.exampleCN: 北侧礁缘上有一座小岛。

items.example: Palms grow on the cay.
items.exampleCN: 棕榈长在小沙岛上。

items.meaning: a reef attached to the shore
items.example: A fringing reef runs along the island.
items.exampleCN: 一条裙礁沿岛延伸。

items.meaning: a reef separated from shore by a lagoon
items.example: The barrier reef shelters the bay.
items.exampleCN: 堡礁为海湾挡浪。

items.example: Coral built the ring over millennia.
items.exampleCN: 珊瑚用千年时间造出这个环。

items.example: Subsidence shaped the atoll.
items.exampleCN: 沉降塑造了这座环礁。

definition_zh: 潟湖；礁湖（被沙洲、沙坝或珊瑚礁隔开的浅水水域）
definition_en: a shallow body of water separated from the open sea by a sandbar, spit or reef
core_image: 一道沙洲把外海的浪挡在外面，里面是一片浅浅的、几乎不动的水
scene: 沙洲把海湾隔出一片浅水，风浪进不来，水面平静得能映出云。The lagoon behind the reef stays calm even in a storm.
sceneCN: 这里 lagoon 指「被礁或沙洲隔开的浅水区」（第 1 个义项：作为水体的潟湖整体）；句意为礁后的潟湖即使在风暴中也保持平静。

pos.zh: 潟湖；礁湖（可数，复数 lagoons）

derivatives.zh: lagoon + -al（形容词后缀）→ 潟湖的：属于潟湖环境的
lacuna（拉丁「水池、空隙」）→ 英语借词：空白、缺失（与 lagoon 同出拉丁 lacuna）
lake（拉丁 lacus「湖」经古法语进入英语）→ 湖（与 lagoon 共享 lacus 词根，但不是派生关系）
lagoon + side（复合名词）→ 潟湖一侧：朝向潟湖的岸段

senses.title: A shallow coastal water body
senses.titleCN: 海岸浅水：被隔开的水体
senses.definition: a shallow stretch of water cut off from the sea by a barrier
senses.definitionCN: 被障壁与海隔开的浅水区域
senses.example: The lagoon behind the reef stays calm even in a storm.
senses.exampleCN: 礁后的潟湖即使在风暴中也保持平静。
senses.why: the barrier is what defines the word: without something separating it from the open sea, shallow water is just shallow sea.
senses.whyCN: 障壁是这个词的定义要素：没有东西把它与外海隔开，浅水就只是浅海。

senses.title: The water inside an atoll
senses.definition: the water enclosed by a ring of coral reef
senses.definitionCN: 被环形珊瑚礁围住的水
senses.example: The atoll lagoon is green over white sand.
senses.exampleCN: 环礁潟湖在白色沙底上呈绿色。
senses.why: an atoll is a ring, and the water it holds is the clearest example of a lagoon.
senses.whyCN: 环礁是一个环，它围住的水正是潟湖最典型的例子。

senses.title: Water behind a sandbar
senses.definition: water trapped behind a beach ridge or spit
senses.definitionCN: 被海滩脊或沙嘴拦住的水
senses.example: Winter storms closed the lagoon mouth with sand.
senses.exampleCN: 冬季风暴用沙封住了潟湖口。
senses.why: a shifting sandbar can seal a river mouth or a bay, creating the still water the word names.
senses.whyCN: 移动的沙坝能封住河口或海湾，造出这个词所命名的静水。

senses.title: A water body with changing salinity
senses.definition: the water considered for its variable salt content and temperature
senses.definitionCN: 从盐度与温度变化角度考虑的水体
senses.example: The lagoon turns brackish after heavy rain.
senses.exampleCN: 大雨之后潟湖变成半咸水。
senses.why: limited exchange with the sea lets rain and evaporation change the water, so the word carries an implied chemistry.
senses.whyCN: 与海水的交换有限，雨水与蒸发因此能改变水质，这个词便隐含了一套化学特征。

senses.title: A nursery habitat
senses.definition: the sheltered water used by juvenile fish and seagrass
senses.definitionCN: 幼鱼与海草利用的受护水域
senses.example: Juvenile fish grow in the lagoon before moving offshore.
senses.exampleCN: 幼鱼在潟湖中长大，再游向外海。
senses.why: calm shallow water with plants is a nursery, so ecology uses the word for that function.
senses.whyCN: 平静的浅水与植物构成育幼场，因此生态学用这个词指那种功能。

senses.title: A stage in coastal infilling
senses.definition: the water body as a stage before it silts up into marsh or land
senses.definitionCN: 在淤积成沼泽或陆地之前的水体阶段
senses.example: The lagoon will become salt marsh within a century.
senses.exampleCN: 这个潟湖在一个世纪内会变成盐沼。
senses.why: sediment always arrives, so a lagoon is geologically temporary and the word can name that stage.
senses.whyCN: 沉积总会到来，因此潟湖在地质上只是暂时，词也可命名那个阶段。

senses.title: An artificial lagoon
senses.definition: a constructed shallow basin used for treatment, storage or recreation
senses.definitionCN: 为处理、储存或休闲而建的浅水池
senses.example: The plant settles solids in an artificial lagoon.
senses.exampleCN: 工厂在人工潟湖中沉降固体。
senses.why: the physical form, shallow still water behind a barrier, is easy to build, so the word extends to engineered basins.
senses.whyCN: 这种形态——障壁后的浅静水——容易建造，因此这个词扩展到工程池。

senses.title: A city built on water
senses.definition: the sheltered water around a historic canal city
senses.definitionCN: 围绕着历史运河城市的受护水域
senses.example: Venice stands on islands inside its lagoon.
senses.exampleCN: 威尼斯建在潟湖中的岛屿上。
senses.why: the Venetian lagoon is the best-known named example, so the word also evokes that urban water setting.
senses.whyCN: 威尼斯潟湖是最著名的专名例子，因此这个词也唤起那种城市水域场景。

intro.en: Lagoon came into English from Italian laguna, which goes back to Latin lacuna 'pool, hollow', a noun built on lacus 'lake'. The Latin root is secure; the chain through Italian is well documented. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: lagoon 从意大利语 laguna 进入英语，后者上溯拉丁 lacuna「水池、凹处」，该名词由 lacus「湖」构成。拉丁词根可靠，经意大利语的链条记载清楚。年代均为约数。

items.en: Lacus meant 'lake, basin' and is the source of Italian lago and French lac.
items.cn: lacus 意为「湖、盆地」，是意大利语 lago 与法语 lac 的来源。

items.en: Lacuna, a derivative of lacus, meant a hollow or a pool; it also gave English lacuna 'a gap'.
items.cn: lacuna 是 lacus 的派生词，意为凹处或水池；它也给出英语 lacuna「空白」。

items.en: Venetian and Italian laguna named the shallow protected water around Venice.
items.cn: 威尼斯方言与意大利语 laguna 指威尼斯周围受护的浅水。

items.en: English borrowed the word in the seventeenth century, first spelling it lagune and later lagoon.
items.cn: 英语于十七世纪借入这个词，先拼作 lagune，后作 lagoon。

items.en: Nineteenth-century geography extended lagoon from Venice to any shallow water behind a reef or bar.
items.cn: 十九世纪地理学把 lagoon 从威尼斯扩展到任何礁或沙坝后的浅水。

items.en: Source uncertain (derivation detail only): whether lacuna is a direct derivative of lacus or an independent formation is debated, so the link is best described as probable rather than proven.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅派生细节存疑）：lacuna 究竟是 lacus 的直接派生还是独立构成，学界有争议，因此两者联系宜说成「可能」而非「已证」。

note.en: Group one holds the coastal water bodies most often confused with a lagoon; group two holds the general words for still inland water.
note.cn: 第一组是常与潟湖混淆的海岸水体；第二组是泛指静水的内陆水体词。

entries.definition: The ring of coral reef itself; a lagoon is the water inside such a ring.
entries.definitionCN: 指珊瑚礁环本身；潟湖是环里的水。

entries.definition: The tidal mouth of a river where fresh and salt water mix; it has an open connection to the sea, unlike a lagoon.
entries.definitionCN: 河流入海的潮汐河口，淡咸水混合；与潟湖不同，它向海敞开。

entries.definition: A broad inlet of the sea into the land; it remains connected to open water and is not cut off by a bar.
entries.definitionCN: 海伸入陆地的宽阔水域；与开阔水域相连，不被沙坝隔断。

entries.definition: Grass-covered muddy ground flooded by tides; it is often the later stage of a lagoon that has silted up.
entries.definitionCN: 受潮水淹没、长满草的泥地；常是潟湖淤积后的后期阶段。

entries.definition: A large body of water surrounded by land; it is usually fresh and inland, not coastal.
entries.definitionCN: 被陆地围绕的大片水域；通常为淡水且在内陆，而非海岸。

entries.definition: A small body of still water, often artificial; it has no connection to the sea.
entries.definitionCN: 小型静水，常为人工；与海没有联系。

entries.definition: A narrow arm of water reaching into land; it stresses the opening rather than the enclosed body.
entries.definitionCN: 伸入陆地的狭窄水域；强调开口，而非被围的水体。

entries.definition: Water cut off from the main flow, often by a bend or a barrier; it need not be coastal or saline.
entries.definitionCN: 与主流隔开的水，常由河湾或障壁造成；不必是海岸或咸水。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real Latin roots, real coastal terms and real stages, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁词根、真实的海岸术语与真实阶段，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: lacus is lake, lacuna is pool: lagoon is the little pool left behind the barrier.
normal.cn: lacus 是湖，lacuna 是水池：潟湖就是障壁后留下的小水池。

normal.en: The barrier decides the word: reef, sandbar or spit must separate it from the open sea.
normal.cn: 障壁决定这个词：必须有礁、沙坝或沙嘴把它与外海隔开。

normal.en: Atoll is the ring, lagoon is the water: the two words fit together like rim and cup.
normal.cn: 环礁是环，潟湖是水：两个词像杯沿与杯中水一样配套。

normal.en: Still water changes chemistry: rain dilutes it, sun concentrates it, exchange with the sea limits both.
normal.cn: 静水会改变化学：雨稀释它，太阳浓缩它，与海的交换又限制两者。

normal.en: A lagoon is temporary: sediment fills it and marsh follows.
normal.cn: 潟湖是暂时的：沉积填满它，沼泽随后而来。

abstract.en: A lagoon is the sea resting behind a door it cannot open.
abstract.cn: 潟湖是停在一扇它打不开的门后的海。

abstract.en: It is a shallow memory of the ocean, kept by sand.
abstract.cn: 它是海洋一段浅浅的记忆，由沙保存。

abstract.en: Calm here is borrowed time: the barrier will move.
abstract.cn: 这里的平静是借来的时间：障壁终会移动。

examples.en: The lagoon supports seagrass beds and juvenile fish.
examples.cn: 这片潟湖供养着海草床与幼鱼。

examples.en: Sand closed the lagoon mouth during the dry season.
examples.cn: 旱季时沙封住了潟湖口。

examples.en: The lagoon water warmed to thirty degrees in summer.
examples.cn: 夏季潟湖水温升到三十度。

dict_mnemonic.text: lagoon（潟湖）来自意大利 laguna，上溯拉丁 lacuna「水池」；记成「沙坝或礁后的一池浅水」，静、浅、盐度多变。

root: 意大利语 laguna ← 拉丁 lacuna「水池、凹处」← lacus「湖」；经法语或意大利语于十七世纪进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one sheltered water body: the coastal basin, the atoll's inner sea, the bar behind sand, its shifting chemistry, its nursery role, its silting stage, its artificial copy and its city setting.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一片受护水域展开：海岸盆地、环礁内海、沙坝后的水、变化的化学、育幼功能、淤积阶段、人工复制与城市水域。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: waves stop at a sandbar while the water behind it lies almost flat.
core.cn: 核心意象：浪停在沙洲外，沙洲后的水几乎不动。

branches.en: THREE BARRIERS: coast, coral ring and sandbar each enclose the same kind of water.
branches.cn: 三种障壁：海岸、珊瑚环与沙坝各自围出同一类水。

branches.en: CHEMISTRY: restricted exchange lets salinity and temperature drift.
branches.cn: 化学：交换受限使盐度与温度漂移。

branches.en: NURSERY: calm shallow water becomes a shelter for the young.
branches.cn: 育幼场：平静浅水成为幼体的庇护所。

branches.en: TEMPORARY AND BUILT: silt ends it, engineering copies it.
branches.cn: 暂时与仿建：淤积终结它，工程复制它。

branches.en: CITY WATER: a historic city makes the lagoon its ground.
branches.cn: 城市水域：一座历史城市把潟湖当作地基。

intro.en: Lagoon is a borrowed noun whose Latin ancestry is clear but whose English form carries no productive affix except the adjective ending -al.
intro.cn: lagoon 是借入名词，拉丁来源清楚，但英语形式除形容词后缀 -al 外不带能产词缀。

latinIntro.en: Lacus and lacuna are the Latin entries; Italian laguna is the intermediate form, not a Latin word.
latinIntro.cn: lacus 与 lacuna 是拉丁条目；意大利语 laguna 是中间形式，并非拉丁词。

items.structure: lacus, lacus (Latin noun, masculine, fourth declension)
items.example: Lacus is the source of Italian lago.
items.exampleCN: lacus 是意大利语 lago 的来源。

items.structure: lacuna, lacunae (Latin noun, feminine, first declension)
items.example: Lacuna passed into English as a word for a gap.
items.exampleCN: lacuna 作为「空白」义进入英语。

items.example: The Venetian laguna surrounds the old city.
items.exampleCN: 威尼斯潟湖环绕着老城。

items.example: The lagoon lies behind the barrier island.
items.exampleCN: 潟湖位于障壁岛之后。

items.meaning: of or belonging to a lagoon
items.example: Lagoonal muds preserve fine layers.
items.exampleCN: 潟湖泥保存着细密的层理。

items.meaning: the opening where lagoon water meets the sea
items.meaningCN: 潟湖水与海相接的开口
