items.example: A buoy marks the channel.
items.exampleCN: 一个浮标标出航道。

items.example: The suffix turns an adjective into a quality noun.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把形容词变成性质名词。

items.example: Buoyancy, vacancy and brilliancy share the ending.
items.exampleCN: buoyancy、vacancy 与 brilliancy 共用这个词尾。

items.meaning: the state of floating; upward force
items.example: The vest provides buoyancy.
items.exampleCN: 救生衣提供浮力。

items.example: The raft was buoyant enough to carry two.
items.exampleCN: 木筏的浮力足以载两个人。

items.example: She walked buoyantly into the room.
items.exampleCN: 她轻快地走进房间。

items.meaning: a device that helps a person float
items.example: Every canoe carries a buoyancy aid.
items.exampleCN: 每艘独木舟都带助浮具。

items.meaningCN: 潜水员可调节的浮力背心
items.example: He inflated the buoyancy compensator at depth.
items.exampleCN: 他在深处给浮力背心充气。

items.example: Buoyancy equals the weight of the displacement.
items.exampleCN: 浮力等于排开流体的重量。

definition_zh: 有浮力的；能漂浮的；轻快的；乐观的；（市场）保持景气的
definition_en: able to float or keep something afloat; also light-hearted, cheerful or economically firm
core_image: 一块干木被按进水里，手一松就立刻弹回水面，还带着水珠
scene: 一块干木被按进水里，松手后立刻弹回水面。Dry wood is buoyant enough to float for days.
sceneCN: 这里 buoyant 指「具有浮力、能漂浮的」（第 1 个义项：物理上的浮性）；句意为干木的浮力足以使它漂浮数日。

pos.zh: 有浮力的；能漂浮的；轻快的；乐观的；保持景气的

derivatives.zh: buoy + -ancy（拉丁 -antia 抽象名词后缀）→ 浮力；浮性；乐观
buoyant + -ly（副词后缀）→ 轻快地；乐观地
buoy（中古荷兰语 boeye「浮标」）→ 使浮起、鼓舞；浮标
buoyant + plume（羽流）→ 上升羽流：因密度较小而上升的流体柱
buoyant + force（力）→ 浮力：流体对物体的向上作用力

senses.title: Able to float
senses.definition: able to stay on the surface of a liquid
senses.definitionCN: 能留在液体表面而不下沉
senses.example: Dry wood is buoyant enough to float for days.
senses.exampleCN: 干木的浮力足以使它漂浮数日。
senses.why: a thing is buoyant when the fluid pushes up at least as hard as gravity pulls down.
senses.whyCN: 当流体向上推的力至少等于重力向下拉时，物体就是有浮力的。

senses.title: Keeping something afloat
senses.titleCN: 能托住他物的：提供浮力
senses.definition: having enough lift to support a load
senses.definitionCN: 有足够托举力承载负荷
senses.example: The hull is buoyant even with a full cargo.
senses.exampleCN: 船体即使满载货物也有浮力。
senses.why: the adjective can describe not only the floater but also the thing whose lift keeps another object up.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词不仅能描述漂浮者，也能描述以其托举力撑住他物的东西。

senses.title: Rising through a fluid
senses.definition: less dense than the surrounding fluid and therefore rising
senses.definitionCN: 密度小于周围流体因而上升
senses.example: A buoyant plume rises from the vent.
senses.exampleCN: 一股上升羽流从喷口升起。
senses.why: the same density rule that floats a boat lifts a warm plume through colder water.
senses.whyCN: 托起船只的密度规则，同样把暖羽流举过更冷的水。

senses.title: Light-hearted
senses.definition: cheerful and lively in mood
senses.definitionCN: 情绪愉快而活泼
senses.example: The children were buoyant after the race.
senses.exampleCN: 比赛之后孩子们情绪高涨。
senses.why: mood is described with up-down images, and what floats stays up; hence the cheerful sense.
senses.whyCN: 心情用上下意象描述，而浮得起的东西留在上面，于是产生愉快义。

senses.title: Optimistic and resilient
senses.definition: able to recover confidence after difficulty
senses.definitionCN: 困难之后能恢复信心
senses.example: She remained buoyant despite the rejection.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管遭到拒绝，她仍然乐观。
senses.why: coming back to the surface after being pushed down is the physical shape of recovering optimism.
senses.whyCN: 被压下去后回到水面，正是恢复乐观的物理形状。

senses.title: Firm in market terms
senses.definition: active and strong, said of prices, demand or an economy
senses.definitionCN: 指价格、需求或经济活跃而强劲
senses.example: The housing market remained buoyant through the winter.
senses.exampleCN: 住房市场在整个冬季保持景气。
senses.why: prices that do not sink are described as floating high, which is the economic use of the adjective.
senses.whyCN: 不下沉的价格被描述为浮得高，这就是这个形容词的经济用法。

senses.title: Confident in manner
senses.definition: showing easy confidence and high spirits
senses.definitionCN: 表现出从容的自信与高涨的情绪
senses.example: He gave a buoyant wave from the stage.
senses.exampleCN: 他在台上轻快地挥手。
senses.why: the mood sense extends from feeling to visible behaviour, which is how the adjective describes a manner.
senses.whyCN: 情绪义从感受延伸到可见行为，这个形容词因此也能描述举止。

senses.title: Lifting the atmosphere
senses.definition: making a place or event feel cheerful
senses.definitionCN: 使场所或事件显得愉快
senses.example: The music gave the room a buoyant atmosphere.
senses.exampleCN: 音乐给房间带来轻快的气氛。
senses.why: what lifts people's spirits is said to lift the atmosphere itself.
senses.whyCN: 能把人的情绪托起来的东西，也被说成托起了气氛本身。

intro.en: Buoyant is formed in English from buoy plus the Latin-derived adjective suffix -ant, from -antem. The origin of buoy is unsettled; a link to Latin boia 'leather collar' is a hypothesis only. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: buoyant 在英语中由 buoy 加拉丁语源形容词后缀 -ant（来自 -antem）构成。buoy 的来源没有定论，与拉丁 boia「皮制颈环」的联系仅是假说。年代均为约数。

items.en: Buoy came into English in the sixteenth century, probably from Middle Dutch boeye or Old French buie, a float or fetter.
items.cn: buoy 于十六世纪进入英语，可能来自中古荷兰语 boeye 或古法语 buie，指浮标或束缚物。

items.en: Source uncertain: no agreed pre-English source exists, and the Latin boia suggestion remains unproven.
items.cn: 来源不确定：英语之前的来源没有共识，拉丁 boia 的说法未获证明。

items.en: The suffix -ant comes from Latin -antem, the present participle ending used in adjectives such as buoyant and defiant.
items.cn: 后缀 -ant 来自拉丁 -antem，即现在分词词尾，用于 buoyant、defiant 这类形容词。

items.en: The adjective appears in the early eighteenth century for objects that float.
items.cn: 这个形容词于十八世纪初出现，用于会漂浮的物体。

items.en: By the nineteenth century buoyant described spirits and markets as well as hulls.
items.cn: 到十九世纪，buoyant 除船体之外也描述情绪与市场。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the earliest citation differs across dictionaries, though the derivation is clear.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代存疑）：各家词典所给最早书证不同，尽管派生关系清楚。

note.en: Group one holds the adjectives most often confused with buoyant; group two holds the mood and market words with overlapping meaning.
note.cn: 第一组是常与 buoyant 混淆的形容词；第二组是语义重叠的情绪与市场词。

entries.definition: The force or quality itself; buoyant is the adjective describing a thing that has it.
entries.definitionCN: 指力或性质本身；buoyant 是描述具有该性质的形容词。

entries.definition: Able to be floated or transported on water; it is about capability, not the upward force.
entries.definitionCN: 能够漂浮或被水上运输的；说的是能力，不是向上力量。

entries.definition: Resting on the surface now; buoyant says the object can do so, not that it is doing so.
entries.definitionCN: 此刻停在表面；buoyant 说物体能做到，而非正在做。

entries.definition: Covered by water; it is the opposite of floating at the surface.
entries.definitionCN: 被水覆盖；与浮在水面相对。

entries.definition: Happy and pleasant in mood; buoyant adds energy and the image of rising.
entries.definitionCN: 心情愉快和悦；buoyant 更带活力与上升的意象。

entries.definition: Expecting good outcomes; buoyant stresses resilience and lifted spirits rather than prediction.
entries.definitionCN: 预期好结果；buoyant 强调韧性与情绪高涨，而非预测。

entries.definition: Able to recover quickly from difficulty; it is close to the emotional sense of buoyant but less about mood.
entries.definitionCN: 能从困难中迅速恢复；接近 buoyant 的情绪义，但较少涉及心情。

entries.definition: Powerful or firm, used of markets; buoyant is more specific and suggests upward activity.
entries.definitionCN: 强劲有力，可用于市场；buoyant 更具体，暗示向上的活跃。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real physics, real markets and real morphology, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的物理、真实的市场与真实的构词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: buoyant is the adjective of buoyancy: if buoyancy is the push, buoyant is what the push can hold up.
normal.cn: buoyant 是 buoyancy 的形容词：浮力是推力，buoyant 是这股推力托得住的东西。

normal.en: -ant is a present-participle ending, like in defiant: a thing in the act of staying up.
normal.cn: -ant 是现在分词词尾，如 defiant：一个正保持在上面的东西。

normal.en: Three uses in one word: a hull, a mood, a market.
normal.cn: 一个词三种用法：船体、心情、市场。

normal.en: Warm fluid is buoyant because it is lighter than what surrounds it.
normal.cn: 暖流体有浮力，因为它比周围的东西轻。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the senses: buoyant mood, buoyant market, buoyant plume.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出义项：轻快心情、景气市场、上升羽流。

abstract.en: Buoyant is the refusal to stay at the bottom.
abstract.cn: buoyant 是拒绝留在底部的态度。

abstract.en: A buoyant mood is a private life jacket.
abstract.cn: 轻快的心情是一件私人救生衣。

abstract.en: Prices can float, and so can people.
abstract.cn: 价格能浮，人也能浮。

examples.en: Cork is buoyant because it is mostly trapped air.
examples.cn: 软木有浮力，因为它大部分是封住的空气。

examples.en: The team stayed buoyant after the first defeat.
examples.cn: 首场失利后，这支队伍仍然乐观。

examples.en: Buoyant demand pushed prices higher.
examples.cn: 旺盛的需求把价格推高。

dict_mnemonic.text: buoy（浮标）+ -ant（性质）＝能浮的；物理上浮得起，心情上轻快，市场上坚挺，三义同源。

root: buoy（中古荷兰语 boeye 或古法语 buie「浮标、束缚物」，更早来源不确定）+ 拉丁现在分词词尾 -antem → -ant；十八世纪初出现。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one floating quality: a thing that floats, a thing that holds others up, a fluid that rises, a light mood, resilience, a firm market, confident manner and an uplifting atmosphere.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一种漂浮性质展开：会浮的物、能托住他物的物、会上升的流体、轻快心情、韧性、坚挺市场、自信举止与上扬的气氛。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a plank pressed under water springs back to the surface when released.
core.cn: 核心意象：木板被按入水下，一松手就弹回水面。

branches.en: FLOAT AND SUPPORT: the object floats, and the object can hold another up.
branches.cn: 漂浮与支撑：物体自己浮，物体也能托住另一个。

branches.en: CONVECTION: lightness makes a plume climb.
branches.cn: 对流：轻使羽流上升。

branches.en: MOOD: lightness of feeling and recovery after pressure.
branches.cn: 心情：感受的轻快与受压后的恢复。

branches.en: MARKET: prices that stay high and active.
branches.cn: 市场：保持高位与活跃的价格。

branches.en: VISIBLE CHEER: confident manner and a lifted atmosphere.
branches.cn: 可见的愉悦：自信举止与上扬的气氛。

intro.en: Buoyant is a borrowed noun stem plus a Latin participial suffix, so the derivation is fully readable.
intro.cn: buoyant 是借入名词词干加拉丁分词后缀，派生关系完全可读。

latinIntro.en: The suffix -antem is the Latin entry. Buoy has no established Latin ancestor, so no Latin noun is listed for it.
latinIntro.cn: 后缀 -antem 是拉丁条目。buoy 没有已确立的拉丁祖先，因此不列其拉丁名词。

items.example: The buoy marked the reef.
items.exampleCN: 浮标标出礁的位置。

items.example: The ending also shapes defiant and pleasant.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾也构成 defiant 与 pleasant。

items.example: Buoyant and tolerant share the ending.
items.exampleCN: buoyant 与 tolerant 共用这个词尾。

items.example: The raft stayed buoyant.
items.exampleCN: 木筏保持漂浮。

items.meaning: the force or quality of floating
items.example: The diver checks buoyancy first.
items.exampleCN: 潜水员先检查浮力。

items.meaningCN: 轻快地；带着上扬劲儿地
items.example: He answered buoyantly.
items.exampleCN: 他轻快地回答。

items.example: The buoyant plume reached the thermocline.
items.exampleCN: 上升羽流到达温跃层。

items.meaning: the upward force of a fluid
items.example: The buoyant force equals displaced weight.
items.exampleCN: 浮力等于排开流体的重量。

items.example: Children wear buoyancy aids on the lake.
items.exampleCN: 孩子们在湖上穿助浮衣。

definition_zh: 深海的；远洋深水区的（指远离大陆架、深度很大的海域及其事物）
definition_en: relating to the deep parts of the ocean, far from land and below the continental shelf
core_image: 潜器灯照进没有光的黑水，一只苍白的鱼慢慢飘过，四周只有细小的雪状颗粒落下
scene: 带灯的潜器在漆黑的海底缓慢前进，照出一只苍白的鱼。Cameras designed for deep-sea work caught a pale fish drifting past the vent.
sceneCN: 这里 deep-sea 指「属于深海环境的」（第 1 个义项：深海区域及其事物）；句意为为深海作业设计的相机拍到一条苍白的鱼从喷口旁漂过。

pos.zh: 深海的；深海使用的（多作定语，如 deep-sea fish、deep-sea exploration）

derivatives.zh: deep（古英语 deop「深的」）→ 深的；深处地
sea（古英语 sæ「海」）→ 海
deep + water（复合形容词）→ 深水的：与深海或深水港有关的
deep-sea（深海的）+ fish（鱼，古英语 fisc）→ 深海鱼：生活在阳光层以下的鱼类
abyssus（希腊「无底」经拉丁借入）+ -al → 深渊的：深海平原一带的

senses.title: The deep ocean region
senses.titleCN: 深海区域：远离陆架的深水海域
senses.definition: the part of the ocean beyond the shelf and below its surface waters
senses.definitionCN: 海洋中超出大陆架、位于表层水之下的部分
senses.example: Cameras designed for deep-sea work caught a pale fish drifting past the vent.
senses.exampleCN: 为深海作业设计的相机拍到一条苍白的鱼从喷口旁漂过。
senses.why: deep supplies depth and sea supplies the body of water, so the compound names the ocean's deep zone.
senses.whyCN: deep 提供深度，sea 提供水体，复合词因此命名海洋的深水区。

senses.title: The deep-sea environment
senses.titleCN: 深海环境：黑暗、高压、低温
senses.definition: the conditions of darkness, high pressure and cold found at depth
senses.definitionCN: 深水处黑暗、高压与低温的条件
senses.example: Deep-sea conditions make every dive a technical problem.
senses.exampleCN: 深海条件使每次下潜都成为技术难题。
senses.why: naming the zone also names what the zone is like, and those conditions define the technology used there.
senses.whyCN: 命名区域也就命名了区域的样子，而这些条件决定了那里使用的技术。

senses.title: Deep-sea organisms
senses.definition: the animals living below the sunlit layer
senses.definitionCN: 生活在阳光层之下的动物
senses.example: A deep-sea fish may never see sunlight.
senses.exampleCN: 一条深海鱼可能一生见不到阳光。
senses.why: the habitat word attaches to its inhabitants, which is the most common biological use.
senses.whyCN: 栖息地词附在其居民上，这是最常见的生物用法。

senses.title: Deep-sea technology
senses.definition: the vehicles, cameras and sensors built for great depth
senses.definitionCN: 为极大深度建造的潜器、相机与传感器
senses.example: Deep-sea vehicles must withstand enormous pressure.
senses.exampleCN: 深海潜器必须承受巨大压力。
senses.why: ordinary equipment fails at depth, so a separate technical category is named after the zone.
senses.whyCN: 普通设备在深处失效，因此按区域命名出一个独立的技术类别。

senses.title: Deep-sea deposits
senses.definition: the sediments and rocks of the abyssal seafloor
senses.definitionCN: 深渊海底的沉积物与岩石
senses.example: Deep-sea sediment accumulates only millimetres per thousand years.
senses.exampleCN: 深海沉积物每一千年才堆积几毫米。
senses.why: geology uses the same modifier for materials that settle far from land.
senses.whyCN: 地质学用同一个限定词指远离陆地的沉降材料。

senses.title: Deep-sea resources
senses.definition: the minerals and energy resources of the deep ocean
senses.definitionCN: 深海的矿产与能源资源
senses.example: Deep-sea mining targets manganese nodules.
senses.exampleCN: 深海采矿以锰结核为目标。
senses.why: once metals and gas were found at depth, the zone word became an economic category.
senses.whyCN: 一旦在深处发现金属与天然气，区域词就成为经济类别。

senses.title: Deep-sea ecosystems
senses.titleCN: 深海生态系统：热液与冷泉
senses.definition: the chemosynthetic communities of vents, seeps and abyssal plains
senses.definitionCN: 喷口、渗漏与深渊平原上的化能合成群落
senses.example: Deep-sea ecosystems rely on falling food and chemical energy.
senses.exampleCN: 深海生态系统依靠落下的食物与化学能。
senses.why: the deep sea is not empty, and ecology needed the same word for its distinctive communities.
senses.whyCN: 深海并非空无，生态学需要同一个词来指其独特群落。

senses.title: Deep-sea fishing
senses.definition: fishing carried out far offshore in deep water
senses.definitionCN: 在远离海岸的深水区进行的捕捞
senses.example: Deep-sea fishing fleets work weeks away from port.
senses.exampleCN: 深海渔船队离港作业数周。
senses.why: industry uses the phrase for the distance and depth of the grounds rather than for the biology.
senses.whyCN: 产业用这个短语指渔场的距离与深度，而非生物本身。

intro.en: Deep-sea is a native English compound: deep from Old English deop, sea from Old English sæ. It has no Latin ancestry. The hyphenated adjective is recorded from the nineteenth century. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: deep-sea 是英语本族复合词：deep 来自古英语 deop，sea 来自古英语 sæ。它没有拉丁语祖先。带连字符的形容词形式自十九世纪有记载。年代均为约数。

items.en: Deop meant 'deep' and is related to German tief and Dutch diep.
items.cn: deop 意为「深的」，与德语 tief、荷兰语 diep 同源。

items.en: Sæ meant 'sea, lake' and survives in English sea and in compounds such as seaman.
items.cn: sæ 意为「海、湖」，存留于英语 sea 以及 seaman 等复合词中。

items.en: Deep-sea appears in the nineteenth century, first describing fishing grounds far from land.
items.cn: deep-sea 于十九世纪出现，最初描述远离陆地的渔场。

items.en: Twentieth-century research gave the compound its scientific sense of the zone below the shelf and sunlight.
items.cn: 二十世纪的研究赋予这个复合词科学义：陆架与阳光层之下的区域。

items.en: Late twentieth-century mining and energy interests added deep-sea resources and deep-sea mining.
items.cn: 二十世纪后期的采矿与能源利益又增添了深海资源与深海采矿。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the earliest citation of the hyphenated adjective varies between references, though both elements are well recorded.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代存疑）：带连字符形容词的最早书证各家不一，尽管两个成分记载清楚。

note.en: Group one holds the ocean-zone terms most often confused with deep-sea; group two holds the adjectives for depth and distance.
note.cn: 第一组是常与 deep-sea 混淆的海洋区域术语；第二组是表示深度与距离的形容词。

entries.tag: far from shore, not necessarily deep
entries.definition: Water beyond the shelf, but its depth varies; open ocean stresses distance from land, deep-sea stresses depth.
entries.definitionCN: 陆架之外的水域，但深度不一；open ocean 强调离陆远，deep-sea 强调深。

entries.definition: Relating to the abyssal zone, roughly four to six thousand metres; it is narrower than deep-sea.
entries.definitionCN: 指深渊带，约四到六千米深；比 deep-sea 窄。

entries.definition: A near-synonym used for ports, oil wells and shipping channels; it often means simply 'not shallow'.
entries.definitionCN: 近义词，用于港口、油井与航道；常只表示「不浅」。

entries.definition: Away from the shore, often within the shelf; it says nothing about great depth.
entries.definitionCN: 远离海岸，常仍在大陆架上；不涉及很大深度。

entries.definition: Extending far down from a surface; it needs a noun to become the ocean term.
entries.definitionCN: 从表面向下延伸很远；需要名词才能成为海洋术语。

entries.definition: Relating to the open ocean rather than coastal waters; it does not specify depth.
entries.definitionCN: 指开阔海洋而非沿岸水域；不限定深度。

entries.definition: Beneath the sea surface; it gives position, not the depth zone.
entries.definitionCN: 海面之下；给出位置，而非深度带。

entries.definition: Relating to the seafloor, shallow or deep; it names a surface rather than a depth range.
entries.definitionCN: 指海床，浅深皆可；命名的是表面，不是深度范围。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: two real native words and real ocean zones, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：两个真实的本族词与真实的海洋区域，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: deep plus sea is literally the deep part of the sea: no buried meaning.
normal.cn: deep 加 sea 字面就是海的深处：没有隐藏含义。

normal.en: The word is Germanic: compare German tief and Dutch diep for deep.
normal.cn: 这个词是日耳曼语：比较德语 tief 与荷兰语 diep 的「深」。

normal.en: Below the sunlit layer the food is falling debris, not photosynthesis.
normal.cn: 阳光层之下，食物是落下的碎屑，而非光合作用。

normal.en: Pressure adds one atmosphere per ten metres, so deep-sea equipment must be sealed.
normal.cn: 每十米增加一个大气压，因此深海设备必须密封。

normal.en: Fixed compounds mark the fields: deep-sea fish, deep-sea mining, deep-sea trench.
normal.cn: 固定复合词标出领域：深海鱼、深海采矿、深海沟。

abstract.en: The deep sea is a country with no weather and no dawn.
abstract.cn: 深海是一个没有天气也没有黎明的国度。

abstract.en: It is the planet's cold memory, kept under pressure.
abstract.cn: 它是这颗行星寒冷的记忆，被压力保存。

abstract.en: Light stops, and life continues without it.
abstract.cn: 光在那里停止，生命却继续。

examples.en: Deep-sea explorers mapped a trench five kilometres down.
examples.cn: 深海探索者测绘了一条五千米深的沟。

examples.en: Deep-sea fish often have large eyes and slow metabolism.
examples.cn: 深海鱼常有大眼睛与缓慢的代谢。

examples.en: The debate over deep-sea mining concerns seabed damage.
examples.cn: 关于深海采矿的争论集中在海床损害。

dict_mnemonic.text: deep（深）+ sea（海）＝深海的；远离陆架、无光高压，衍生出深海鱼、深海采矿、深海沉积等固定说法。

root: 古英语 deop「深的」+ 古英语 sæ「海」构成的英语复合词；属日耳曼语族，无拉丁语源，十九世纪成形。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one depth zone: the region, its conditions, its organisms, its technology, its deposits, its resources, its ecosystems and its fisheries.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个深度带展开：区域、条件、生物、技术、沉积、资源、生态系统与渔业。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lamp in black water, a pale fish, and a slow fall of particles like snow.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑水中的一盏灯，一条苍白的鱼，以及像雪一样缓慢落下的颗粒。

branches.en: REGION AND CONDITIONS: the zone itself, then its darkness, cold and pressure.
branches.cn: 区域与条件：先是区域本身，再是它的黑暗、低温与压力。

branches.en: LIFE AND ECOSYSTEM: the animals, then the communities they form.
branches.cn: 生命与生态：先是动物，再是它们形成的群落。

branches.en: TECHNOLOGY: vehicles and cameras built to survive the zone.
branches.cn: 技术：为在该区域存活而造的潜器与相机。

branches.en: DEPOSIT AND RESOURCE: what settles there, and what is mined there.
branches.cn: 沉积与资源：那里沉下什么，那里开采什么。

branches.en: FISHERY: the zone treated as a distant fishing ground.
branches.cn: 渔业：把该区域当作遥远的渔场。

intro.en: Deep-sea is a two-word compound of free English morphemes, with no affix; the hyphen marks it as an adjective.
intro.cn: deep-sea 是两个自由英语语素构成的复合词，不带词缀；连字符标明它作形容词。

latinIntro.en: Both halves are Germanic, so no Latin entries are listed. Latin altus 'deep' and mare 'sea' are different roots, not cognates.
latinIntro.cn: 两半都属日耳曼语，因此不列拉丁条目。拉丁 altus「深」与 mare「海」是不同词根，并非同源。

items.example: The water is deep beyond the reef.
items.exampleCN: 礁外的水很深。

items.meaning: sea; large body of salt water
items.example: The sea was calm that morning.
items.exampleCN: 那天早晨海很平静。

items.example: Deep-sea animals tolerate great pressure.
items.exampleCN: 深海动物能忍受巨大压力。

items.meaning: the deep ocean as a place
items.example: The deep sea covers most of the planet.
